vrm-addon.title: VRM Add-on v4.0.0
vrm-addon.summary: 4.0.0 (2026-05-06) 💥 BREAKING CHANGES remove deprecated compatibility APIs and aliases removed deprecated operator IDs: vrm.add_vrm1_arkit_custom_expressions -> use vrm.assign_vrm1_expressions_from_arkit vrm.assign_vrm1_mmd_expressions -> use…
vrm-addon.html:
4.0.0 (2026-05-06)

💥 BREAKING CHANGES

  • remove deprecated compatibility APIs and aliases

    • removed deprecated operator IDs:
      • vrm.add_vrm1_arkit_custom_expressions -> use vrm.assign_vrm1_expressions_from_arkit
      • vrm.assign_vrm1_mmd_expressions -> use vrm.assign_vrm1_expressions_from_mmd
      • vrm.assign_vrm1_ready_player_me_expressions -> use vrm.assign_vrm1_expressions_from_ready_player_me
      • vrm.assign_vrm1_vrchat_expressions -> use vrm.assign_vrm1_expressions_from_vrchat
    • removed deprecated operator argument alias armature_name; use armature_object_name
    • removed deprecated property aliases:
      • MeshObjectPropertyGroup.value -> use MeshObjectPropertyGroup.mesh_object_name
      • BonePropertyGroup.value -> use BonePropertyGroup.bone_name

  • fix class and bl_idname mismatches by renaming IDs to match current class names

    • VRM_PT_vrm1_spring_bone_armature_object_property -> VRM_PT_spring_bone1_armature_object_property
    • VRM_PT_vrm1_spring_bone_ui -> VRM_PT_spring_bone1_ui
    • VRM_UL_vrm0_material_color_bind -> VRM_UL_vrm1_material_color_bind
    • VRM_IMPORTER_PT_export_error_messages -> VRM_PT_export_file_browser_tool_props

gh-5hyuns-maya-workflow-kit-for-blender.summary: 0.15.0 — A Maya Outliner tree with joints, Ctrl+D makes a plain copy, camera gates and fits like Maya, Render Sequence per camera again, faster Maya-mode playback, Traditional Chinese, and the fixes from your reports (Blender 5.2 LTS) Install it over 0.14.0…
gh-5hyuns-maya-workflow-kit-for-blender.html:
0.15.0 — A Maya Outliner tree with joints, Ctrl+D makes a plain copy, camera gates and fits like Maya, Render Sequence per camera again, faster Maya-mode playback, Traditional Chinese, and the fixes from your reports (Blender 5.2 LTS)

Install it over 0.14.0 (or 0.8.0 – 0.13.0) as usual; shelves, hotkeys, scenes and the kit's settings are kept. (Removing the kit before installing deletes them: use Export Settings first.) Supported: Blender 5.2 LTS. Other versions are not tested: the extension still installs on Blender 5.0 and 5.1, but they may have problems. For Blender 4.5 LTS keep using 0.6.2. Blender 5.3 support is in progress.

New

  • Traditional Chinese translation of the kit's menus, marking menus, shelves and tooltips (from @yoyomaimai, #341).
  • Render > Render Sequence renders every camera whose Renderable check is on again, one after another, each camera's frames in its own folder; in Maya mode Render Settings has a Common panel with Skip existing frames and Renderable Cameras (#252).
  • Modify > Match Transformations: all five items open option windows (#350).
  • Texture file browsers start in the project's sourceimages folder in Maya mode (#349).
  • Alt+LMB+MMB zooms the Graph Editor, Dope Sheet, Node Editor, NLA and UV Editor like their Alt+RMB (#325).
  • Viewport panel toolbar: Bookmarks (also View > Bookmarks and a Bookmark Editor) and 2D Pan/Zoom work (#346).
  • View > Camera Tools > 2D Pan/Zoom Tool is a tool: drag to pan or zoom, Ctrl+drag zooms into a box (#346).

Changed

  • The \ key works like Maya's 2D Pan/Zoom in every view: tap it to turn 2D Pan/Zoom on or off, hold it and middle-drag to pan, right-drag to zoom (before, \ + left drag panned and \ + middle drag zoomed) (#346).
  • Ctrl+D, Shift+D and Smart Duplicate make a plain copy, like Maya: the geometry as it shows at the current frame, without history, deformers, shape keys, keys or constraints, so animating the original no longer moves the copy; particle systems (hair) and Collision are not copied. Duplicate Special's new Duplicate input graph and Duplicate input connections options give the other kinds of copy (input connections is what Ctrl+D did before) (#347).
  • The last picked object leads after a box, lasso, Outliner range or Select All too: Match Transformations takes it as the source, and in Maya mode it is the active object the Channel Box, Attribute Editor and selection wire show (#338).
  • New cameras start with the fit Maya gives them: Fill for Create > Cameras, Horizontal for the persp / top / front / side cameras of a new scene; older cameras keep Blender's Auto fit (#345).
  • The Maya Outliner is a Maya tree drawn by the kit: joints are rows under their parent joint (#348 — the joints couldn't be seen before), objects in creation order, sets last; click / Ctrl / Shift picks, a left drag selects, a middle drag parents, double-click or Enter renames, F reveals the selection, and the right-click menu has Shapes, Reveal Selected, Hide In Outliner, Sets, Display and Show.
  • Create Camera From View (Ctrl+Shift+C, panel View menu) copies the camera the view looks through, the view looks through the copy and the selection stays; Panels > Orthographic has New > Front / Back / Right / Left / Top / Bottom.
  • Component mode D / Insert keeps the Move / Rotate / Scale manipulator with pivot handles (with other tools, the Select tool included, they do nothing), and a placed component pivot moves with the components (#351).
  • Render > Render Sequence runs with the options saved in its window; options saved with 0.8.0 are used again, so check its option box once (#252).

Fixed

  • Alt+LMB+MMB dolly: letting go of one button carries on with the one still held (#343).
  • Faster playback in Maya mode with rigged characters (#344).
  • Camera gates: the Film Gate is the film back and sits on the Resolution Gate like Maya, and the Attribute Editor's Fit Resolution Gate has Fill, Horizontal, Vertical and Overscan (#345).
  • Soften Edge, Harden Edge and Soften/Harden Edges show their result on meshes with history, and one Ctrl+Z takes it back in component mode (#342).
  • Edge slides keep the UV layout, and Preserve UVs gives the right UVs with the Scale tool and the Universal Manipulator (#340).
  • Auto Key keys a changed constraint weight that already has keys (#329).
  • Panels > Tear Off / Tear Off Copy keep the panel menu bar and toolbar (#346).
  • The option box works in menus opened from the Space hotbox (#350).
  • The UV Editing shelf's UV Editor button opens the UV Editor window (#352).
  • UV Unfold no longer freezes Blender on dense meshes, and UV > Sew UV Edges, Merge UVs, Cut UV Edges, Delete UVs, Split UVs and Auto Seams use the 3D View selection when UV Sync Selection is off and no UV is picked (#354).

Known differences

  • Component pivot: Undo doesn't yet take back an edit of the pivot alone (moving it with D); Maya's Undo does.
  • Duplicate input graph: the copy's deformers still use the original's skeleton, lattice or cluster handles; Maya copies those too.
  • Outliner: Blender edits joints in Pose Mode, so a joint and a mesh can't be picked together; Ctrl+clicking a mesh row after a joint keeps the whole skeleton selected with it (what Bind Skin needs).
  • Saving the scene while Render Sequence renders several cameras saves the camera and output folder of the camera being rendered; save before or after the sequence.
  • 2D Pan/Zoom in Blender's own persp view: it has no film offset, so the kit turns the view about its eye and narrows its lens (the zoom stops at 250 mm); views that look through a camera and the top / front / side views pan and zoom exactly like Maya.
  • The known differences listed in CHANGELOG.md still apply.

Thank you

Thanks to @yoyomaimai for the Traditional Chinese translation (#341), and for the reports and ideas: @mfjooste (#325), @ArcticZA (#329, #338), @kwaksaemi1028-commits (#340), @psokk (#342), @Nichosen (#343), @pixelkeyblade18 (#344), @rethink-studios (#345), @haithamcolorcolor-spec (#346), @Fizkefaaz (#347), @Arminanimator (#348), @DAI3rd (#349, #252), @KMller (#350), @Drawingonwhite (#351), @jadelion-creator (#352) and @sushilthakur236 (#354). Please keep telling us what breaks or feels off in real work.

gh-5hyuns-maya-workflow-kit-for-blender.html:
0.14.0 — Shelf Editor, editable Bridge and modeling-node channels, In-View Editor middle drag, Transform Component rotate ring, and the fixes from your reports (Blender 5.2 LTS)

Install it over 0.13.0 (or 0.8.0 – 0.12.0) as usual; shelves, hotkeys, scenes and the kit's settings are kept. (Removing the kit before installing deletes them: use Export Settings first.) Supported: Blender 5.2 LTS. Other versions are not tested: the extension still installs on Blender 5.0 and 5.1, but they may have problems. For Blender 4.5 LTS keep using 0.6.2.

New

  • Windows > Settings/Preferences > Shelf Editor: add, rename, reorder and delete shelves and buttons, and edit a button's label, icon, tooltip and command; changes stay a draft until Save (from @LoongVeeng, #310).
  • In-View Editor: a plain middle drag anywhere in the view changes the yellow row, and a middle click picks a row without changing it. New options in Preferences, all off: a drag-speed control in the In-View Editor's title, moving the In-View Editor by its title, and the marking menu's Quick Gestures and Submenu Return Ring (from @LoongVeeng, #301).
  • Ctrl + left / middle / right drag on number fields (Attribute Editor, Channel Box, option windows, sidebar) in fine / normal / coarse steps; Channel Box INPUTS rows of a modeling node (Extrude, Bevel, Bridge, Add Divisions) work as channels you can select, middle-drag in the view, type into together and lock; Display > Heads Up Display > In-View Editors (from @youngmin2k, #326).
  • Edit Mesh > Bridge makes an editable polyBridgeEdge node with Bridge Type, Divisions, Twist, Taper, Bridge Offset, Direction, Smoothing Angle and a Taper Curve graph; Add Divisions makes an editable polySubdFace node. Two new options, both off: Persistent Modeling History and Option Boxes in Floating Windows (from @youngmin2k, #326).
  • Edit Mesh > Transform (Transform Component) has the rotate ring and the world / local switch on its manipulator (#321).
  • T in object mode stays in object mode and shows the newest input node's manipulator and In-View Editor, a primitive's creation node included; the node picked in Channel Box INPUTS wins (#327).
  • Time Slider shows exactly the playback range, the Range Slider row fits short timelines without a scrollbar, and Playblast brings its player to the front (#319).

Changed

  • Simplified Chinese translation: about 300 labels and tooltips corrected (from @RIPTIDE-z, #260).

Fixed

  • Nonlinear deformers (Bend, Twist, Squash, Flare, Sine, Wave) can be keyed with S, Key Selected and Auto Key, and play back (#339).
  • Graph Editor: a dragged tangent handle end stays under the mouse.
  • Keyed constraint target weights drive the constraint while you scrub, on objects and joints; S keys the open constraint's weights, also with the mouse over the Channel Box or another panel. One target follows any weight above 0 and 0 leaves the node on its own channels; with two or more targets, every weight 0 puts the node back on its own place, like Maya (#329).
  • Modify > Match Transformations takes the last picked node as the source, rig controls included (#338).
  • Mesh > Fill Hole closes the selected border loops, and Bridge closes a single border loop with one face (#337).

Known differences

  • In-View Editor: a middle drag changes values more slowly than Maya's, and the editor sits beside its object rather than at a fixed place in the view.
  • Bridge: a plain click makes no divisions, unlike Maya; set Divisions in the Channel Box or Bridge Options.
  • The known differences listed in CHANGELOG.md still apply.

Thank you

Thanks to @LoongVeeng for the Shelf Editor and the In-View Editor / marking menu work (#310, #301), @youngmin2k for the shared attribute editing and the Bridge node (#326) and @RIPTIDE-z for the Chinese translation (#260), and for the reports and ideas: @swarnava05 (#319), @Olivier-bit (#321), @psokk (#327), @ArcticZA (#329, #338), @GUYVERZERO (#337) and @Fizkefaaz (#339). Please keep telling us what breaks or feels off in real work.

gh-5hyuns-maya-workflow-kit-for-blender.html:
0.13.0 — Smart Bevel, modular Graph Editor windows, Connect Tool, Universal Manipulator on components, and the fixes from your reports (Blender 5.2 LTS)

Install it over 0.12.0 (or 0.8.0 – 0.11.0) as usual; shelves, hotkeys, scenes and the kit's settings are kept. (Removing the kit before installing deletes them: use Export Settings first.) Supported: Blender 5.2 LTS. Other versions are not tested: the extension still installs on Blender 5.0 and 5.1, but they may have problems. For Blender 4.5 LTS keep using 0.6.2.

New

  • Edit Mesh > Smart Bevel, Maya 2027's bevel: a width in scene units kept below what the edges around allow, edge filters (Selected / Hard / by Angle), border edges set hard, smoothing angle and arc welding, as an editable polySmartBevel node with a Width arrow; also in the Modeling Toolkit and the Shift+RMB menus (#303).
  • Universal Manipulator on components: Ctrl+T in a component mode puts the box around the selected vertices, edges or faces; corners scale, edge arrows rotate, the centre moves, a typed length sets the size (#318).
  • Modular editor windows: the Graph Editor, Dope Sheet and UV Editor panes have a Panels menu with Tear Off / Tear Off Copy, and a floating editor window docks back at the bottom, left, right or top of the viewport (#319).
  • Skeleton > HumanIK leads to Rigify: meta-rig, Generate Rig, rig settings, bone rig type and rig controls (#319).
  • Connect Tool: Mesh Tools > Connect is interactive, with Slide / Segments / Pinch, a middle-drag that re-does the last connection and Maya's selection rules (#322).
  • Edit Mesh > Transform as an editable node, Extrude along a selected curve, edge extrusion that keeps connected edges together, Insert Knot that keeps the curve's shape, UDIM grid option, Light Linking editors (#321).
  • Booleans keep construction history and Delete takes a result's hidden inputs with it (#324).
  • Panel toolbar camera list (every camera, New Perspective / Orthographic, Stereo Cameras) and Alt+LMB+MMB dolly (#325).
  • Constraint target weights are Channel Box channels you can select and key (#329).
  • Joint Size in Metre Scenes preference (#328); Radius to Hierarchy and B-Bone / Envelope bone display (#320).
  • Search and Replace Names takes $ and ^ like Maya; Grow / Shrink Selection on non-US keyboards and in the UV Editor (#322).
  • Selection highlight (green lead, white others) in Rendered shading (#330).
  • T shows the last extrude / bevel manipulator and In-View Editor (#327).

Fixed

  • Channel Box clicks respond at once: only the editors that show the channels redraw (#316).
  • Outliner h hides exactly the picked rows (#322); a box over rig controls picks every control in it (#323).
  • Edge bevels in centimetre scenes keep their edges (#321); a 3-segment bevel shades its strips alike (#331).
  • Marking menus: a radial submenu goes back to its parent menu (#332); G after Ctrl+G groups again (#333); a kit window is not written to disk while it is dragged (#334); a joint Radius confirmed with Enter redraws at once (#320).
  • Time Slider: a double-click highlights the whole visible range like Maya, and no "Toggle Channel Editability" panel is left over the slider (#335). h in a scene saved by an earlier version no longer shows an old hidden object while hiding the picked one (#336).

Known differences

  • Smart Bevel is this kit's bevel geometry with Maya 2027's options: Cutback Relaxation and Remove Isolated Arcs are not available, and Depth works like Bevel's Depth (1 round, 0 flat, -1 concave).
  • The Universal Manipulator on components goes beyond Maya, which shows no manipulator for a component selection.
  • The known differences listed in CHANGELOG.md still apply.

Thank you

gh-5hyuns-maya-workflow-kit-for-blender.html:
0.12.0 — Universal Manipulator, Graph Editor tangent handles and sculpting brushes, editable motion trails, Stepped Preview, camera Overscan, and the fixes from your reports (Blender 5.2 LTS)

Install it over 0.11.0 (or 0.8.0 – 0.10.0) as usual; shelves, hotkeys, scenes and the kit's settings are kept. (Removing the kit before installing deletes them: use Export Settings first.) Supported: Blender 5.2 LTS. Other versions are not tested: the extension still installs on Blender 5.0 and 5.1, but they may have problems. For Blender 4.5 LTS keep using 0.6.2.

New

  • Universal Manipulator (Ctrl+T in Object Mode): a box around the selection with corner scale, edge rotate, centre move, and box lengths you can click and type (#318).
  • Graph Editor tangent handles like Maya: in Maya mode a non-weighted tangent is drawn at a fixed length on screen and dragging it only turns it; a weighted tangent sits at its real end. A preference turns it off (#296).
  • Graph Editor Sculpting Tools: Grab, Smooth, Smear and Key Reducer brushes; Curves > Clamp Curves and Offset Curves; List > Bookmarks.
  • Keys > Remove Key in the Graph Editor and Dope Sheet: Unsnapped, Before / After Current Frame, Outside Selected Range and Ripple Delete.
  • Motion trails: drag a key marker to move that key, or pick keys and move them with the Move manipulator.
  • Playback: Looping Once / Oscillate, and Enable Stepped Preview (shows every curve stepped without changing the keys).
  • Camera Overscan in the Attribute Editor: a view looking through the camera fits the camera's frame (#313).
  • Camera and Aim rigs draw their aim line in the Maya layout views (#299).
  • Tooltips the kit builds on hover follow the interface language and are in the translation template (#317).
  • The Range Slider fills the timeline header (#319).

Fixed

  • Joints are no longer drawn far too large in a scene shown in metres: Radius and Joint Size are centimetres in every scene unit (#311, #320).
  • A Radius typed in the Channel Box goes to every selected joint and redraws at once; Stick / Wire bone display draws lines (#320).
  • Kit-drawn panels (Graph Editor list, Time Slider, Range Slider) follow the Blender theme (#312).
  • Channel Box: a clicked channel shows its highlight at once (#316); the right-click menu opens left of the Channel Box (#315).
  • Your own translation file now wins over Blender's translation in the kit's menus, shelf and Channel Box (#317).
  • Graph Editor tangent buttons without the Maya icon row show the kit's tangent pictures (#319).
  • Delete Keys / Cut Keys windows delete exactly the selected keys.

Changed

  • Bevel: a tip where two bevelled edges meet, a corner of three bevelled edges whose angles differ a lot, and an acute corner in Fraction mode come closer to Maya's shape. The three-edge corner is an approximation and still differs from Maya (#213).

Known differences

  • Universal Manipulator: the rotate speed and the point that stays fixed when you type a length may feel a little different from Maya. In component modes Ctrl+T stays Blender's Transform tool.
  • The known differences listed in CHANGELOG.md still apply.

Thank you

0.11.0 — Trax Editor clips, Maya's UV Editor marking menus, camera rigs, a Maya / Blender keyboard switch, your own translations, and the fixes from your reports (Blender 5.2 LTS)

Install it over 0.10.0 (or 0.8.0 / 0.9.0) as usual; shelves, hotkeys, scenes and the kit's settings are kept. (Removing the kit before installing deletes them: use Export Settings first.) Supported: Blender 5.2 LTS. Other versions are not tested: the extension still installs on Blender 5.0 and 5.1, but they may have problems. For Blender 4.5 LTS keep using 0.6.2.

New

  • Trax Editor and animation clips on Blender's NLA: Create > Animation Clip, Insert Clip, Clip Library, Duplicate, Split, Trim, Blend and the other Trax menu items (#287).
  • UV Editor Shift+RMB marking menus like Maya's, for UVs / edges / vertices, UV shells and faces (#298).
  • Create > Cameras > Camera and Aim / Camera, Aim and Up: the camera, its aim and up nodes in camera1_group (#299).
  • Keyboard: Maya / Blender in the add-on preferences and the Hotkey Editor: keep the Maya layout, menus and tools with your Blender keymap (#309).
  • Time for new scenes: File > New Scene and Ctrl+N start at the fps you pick, like Maya's New Scene Options (#308).
  • Click a manipulator handle to make it the active handle, then middle-drag anywhere (#304).
  • The kit's own Rotate manipulator, resized with = / - like Move and Scale (#283).
  • RMB marking menu in Sculpt Mode; middle-drag a camera from the Outliner onto a view to look through it (#294).
  • Your own translations: write a template of every kit text and drop <language code>.json files in the translations folder; the kit follows Blender's interface language (#293). Japanese menu terms follow Japanese Maya (#286).

Fixed

  • Alt+LMB stopped tumbling after a ViewCube click or after pressing Alt again mid-tumble (#288).
  • Alt+RMB dolly follows Invert Zoom Direction (#295).
  • Space tap no longer splits the view again and again on high-DPI screens (#302).
  • Switching to Blender after File > New Scene in Maya mode no longer mixes Maya and Blender tabs (#307).
  • View > Select Camera works in scenes made in Blender mode (#297).
  • No empty strip between the Status Line and the Shelf when the window is maximized (#305).
  • Cut UVs shows the cut edge as a border right away (#298).
  • Joints stay visible after switching workspaces (#289); the Outliner button docks the Outliner instead of opening a new window (#290); hair under a parent hidden with Blender's eye shows up (#291).
  • Edit-mode vertices keep their size on Vulkan and Metal.
  • G keeps the last modeling command after display and selection changes (PR #279); local Bevel is much faster on large meshes (PR #300).

Known differences

  • Graph Editor: a non-weighted tangent keeps Maya's curve shape, but Blender draws the handle at its real point, so it looks longer when turned steeply (#296).
  • The known differences listed in CHANGELOG.md still apply.

Thank you

Thanks for the pull requests: @youngmin2k (#279, #300) and @onlykshitij (#304, #306). Thanks for the reports and ideas: @Fizkefaaz (#283, #291, #297), @DAI3rd (#286, #287, #299, #305, #307, #308), @Adrian-Jansen (#288), @zzador (#289, #290), @Banditik777 (#293), @andych56 (#294), @meanGoreng (#295), @meggaimg70-a11y (#296), @Bit-Nugget (#298), @showtime56521 (#302) and @TomerM7 (#309). Please keep telling us what breaks or feels off in real work.

gh-5hyuns-maya-workflow-kit-for-blender.html:
0.10.0 — a fuller UV Toolkit, Auto Key and Channel Box work on components, a calmer Graph Editor, and the fixes from your reports (Blender 5.2 LTS)

Install it over 0.8.0 or 0.9.0 as usual; shelves, hotkeys, scenes and the kit's settings are kept. (Removing the kit before installing deletes them: use Export Settings first.) Supported: Blender 5.2 LTS. Other versions are not tested: the extension still installs on Blender 5.0 and 5.1, but they may have problems. For Blender 4.5 LTS keep using 0.6.2.

UV editing

  • Every UV Toolkit button now works: Select By Type (Back-Facing, Front-Facing, Overlapping, Non-Overlapping, Texture Borders, Unmapped), all Create, Cut and Sew and Arrange and Layout commands with their option boxes, Align Min / Avg / Max, Unfold Along U / V, Straighten UVs with U / V buttons and an angle tolerance, Stack Similar (#264).
  • UV Edge and UV Face selection apart from the mesh; in the UV Editor a double-click selects a UV edge loop, Ctrl+double-click an edge ring, a double-click on a UV or UV face its shell (#264).
  • Pre-selection for single UVs, UV edges and UV faces, not only whole shells; in UV mode the 3D View shows only the vertices of the picked UVs as selected; no face centre dots in UV mode (#264).
  • Maya-style Move / Rotate / Scale handles in the UV Editor: U / V arrows, a rotate ring, U / V scale boxes at the centre of the selected UVs (#264).
  • Ctrl+Up / Ctrl+Down change the checker density (#264).
  • Straighten UVs and Randomize Shells work like Maya; with several meshes in edit mode the UV commands keep to the shells you picked (#264).

Animation and the Channel Box

  • Auto Key on points: moving keyed points in component mode keys them on the axes that changed; the Time Slider shows the keys of the selected points (#272).
  • blendShape weights go into animation layers, character sets and Set Driven Key; their keys show in the Time Slider (#271).
  • Click the name at the top of the Channel Box to rename the object (#283).
  • Channel Box middle-drag follows the selected Translate axis on screen; Rotate turns 0.36 degrees per pixel (#273).
  • Custom attributes change by 0.1 per pixel when middle-dragged from the Channel Box, like Maya.
  • Lattice points in the Channel Box CVs table, and the Maya manipulator for curve and surface CVs (#274).
  • Auto Key keys only values that change while it is on (#276).

Graph Editor

  • Bigger keys and tangent handles (the Key Size preference; 0 = Blender's own), a toolbar that folds into a » menu when the editor is narrow, and a picture of its own for every toolbar button (#277).
  • Scale Keys box: Shift+drag on a corner scales in time or value only, a drag inside moves the keys; w / e / r work anywhere over the Graph Editor; a snapped key move is one undo (#270).
  • Blender's own Insert Keyframe gets the Default In / Out Tangent too (#267).

Modeling

  • Transform Constraint: Along Normals (#262), and Surface follows the Move handle you drag (#280).
  • Box and Lasso select pick joints with nothing selected (#276); points of a bent lattice are picked where you see them (#274).
  • Bevel at box corners with tilted faces and at three-edge corners follows Maya in more cases (#213).
  • Bevel with Segments 2 or more: round profiles at any face angle, Depth like Maya, and box corners closed with one polygon (#213).
  • Bevel options: Offset space (World) and Chamfer, like Maya's Bevel Options; long absolute offsets slide past short edges like Maya (#213).
  • Bevel hard edges and UVs like Maya: new edges are hard above the Smoothing angle (new option, default 30 degrees), the old faces keep their UVs at the new points, soft bevels get Maya's smooth normals (a display-only Maya Normals modifier), and a cap rim edge's end is one polygon (#213).
  • Type Manipulator: pick single characters of a type and move, rotate or scale them (#258).

Layout, keys and rendering

  • IPR opens its own render window, like Maya's IPR render window (#277).
  • Save your own workspaces: Windows > Workspaces > Save Current Workspace As..., Reset, Delete (#277).
  • Shift+drag on the manipulator shows "Shift Duplicate" / "Shift Extrude" (#277).
  • Numpad digits work like the top row, numpad + / - size the manipulator (#283); Assign Existing Material lists the scene's materials in the marking menu (#283).
  • Other add-ons' top-bar menus and toolbar tools stay in reach in Maya mode (#221).

Fixed

  • Switching from Maya mode back to Blender no longer leaves Maya panels in Blender's Sculpting, UV Editing and Animation workspaces (#282).
  • No TypeError from the kit's timers while Preferences or another temporary window is open (#281).
  • Hotkeys imported with Maya mode off are applied when Maya mode starts (#275).
  • Mesh > Booleans work with three or more objects selected: the first object meets all the others, like Maya (#284).
  • Help menus open the Blender 5.2 manual.

Known differences

  • Bevel: corners where the faces' angles differ strongly (the new corner can sit up to a few percent of the bevel width away), corners whose third edge leans far over and three-edge corners whose face angles differ by more than about 10% still differ from Maya (#213). With Segments 2 or more, corners of three or more bevelled edges where a face holds an unbevelled edge at a sharp tip differ too. The UVs inside rounded bevels and corner polygons are not Maya's yet.
  • The known differences listed in CHANGELOG.md still apply.

Thank you

Thanks for the reports and ideas: @Fizkefaaz (#270, #271, #272, #273, #274, #283), @LoongVeeng (#264), @swarnava05 (#277), @dillanjmurillo (#276), @Marlon90 (#262), @meggaimg70-a11y (#267), @rethink-studios (#275), @martin8762 (#221), @GUYVERZERO (#280), @DAI3rd (#281), @Dark2774 (#282), @slacer (#284) and @gsvetlin-beep (#258). Please keep telling us what breaks or feels off in real work.

gh-5hyuns-maya-workflow-kit-for-blender.html:
0.8.0 — Maya 2026 menus, your own marking menus, Channel Box dragging, Quad Draw and the fixes from your reports (Blender 5.2 LTS)

Install it over 0.7.0 (or 0.6.x / 0.5.0) as usual; shelves, hotkeys, scenes and the kit's settings are kept. For Blender 4.5 LTS keep using 0.6.2.

Added

  • Marking Menu Editor (Windows > Settings/Preferences): change the kit's marking menus in Maya's grid, and make your own marking menus that open with a hotkey the Maya way (#239).
  • Channel Box value dragging: left-drag a value sideways, Ctrl / Shift / Alt for whole steps or finer moves; one drag is one undo step (#224). INPUTS attributes (polyCube1 Subdivisions, Bevel Width ...) can be selected, dragged with the middle mouse in the viewport and keyed like channels (#230, #222).
  • Japanese and Simplified Chinese for the kit's own labels and tooltips, following Blender's language setting (#197).
  • Render Sequence with All Render-Enabled Cameras and Skip existing frames (#252); project AutoSave (#254).
  • Skin Tools weight layers (#127), Hypergraph: Hierarchy (#232), Sweep Mesh that stays editable (#238), Interactive Creation for polygon primitives (#225), Hotkey Editor > Import of a Maya hotkey set (#219), flipped UVs coloured in the UV Editor (#246), Time Slider middle-mouse drag (#255).
  • 75 more FX and Rendering menu items run Blender's own systems (#123).
  • RMB marking menu over a lattice (#227); Shift+W / E / R key Translate / Rotate / Scale from any editor (#212).
  • Alt+B adds Maya's blue gradient; a ViewCube with hover controls; selected wires no longer show their back edges (#216, #224, #243).

Changed

  • Marking menus, the hotbox, Hypershade > Create, the Graph Editor toolbar and the Animation shelf follow Maya 2026.
  • Reset Pivot Position puts an object's pivot on its centre, like Maya; Zero Position on Reset in the pivot-edit menu keeps the old behaviour.
  • Double-click a vertex or face selects its whole shell; Shift+double-click a neighbouring face selects the face loop (#222).
  • Joint Tool: drag after a click to place the joint, with joints, bones and a ghost of the next joint drawn while the tool runs (#230).
  • Quad Draw: Maya's options marking menu, Tab + middle-drag strip width, and a large connections / symmetry / preview update (#89, #231).
  • Display > Polygons is Maya's submenu (#240).
  • A Space tap maximizes any panel of the four view (#214); Ctrl first, then drag a Move handle snaps (#215); Graph Editor Spline / Clamped / Plateau / Flat tangents have Maya's slopes (#210); joints draw like Maya's.

Fixed

  • Undo while the Joint Tool runs takes back one joint (#256); Bind Skin keeps a posed mesh in place, and grouping a skeleton keeps the skin following it (#230).
  • Hypershade Delete Unused Nodes no longer crashes Blender (#251).
  • Other add-ons' keys no longer run before the kit's Maya keys (#218, #250); UV Shell picks show in the UV Editor (#245); the Tool Box column fits on Retina displays (#248); translated menu bar labels fit (#249).
  • Alt+LMB tumble with Emulate 3 Button Mouse (#242), Panels > Tear Off (#255), Graph Editor Shift+drag and middle drag (#211), Target Weld through the mesh (#233), F framing kept ahead of other add-ons' F menus (#237), hiding a group from the Outliner (#223), View > Select Camera (#229).
  • More Bevel cases like Maya (#213), NURBS surfaces (Extrude Tube, Boundary / Square, Birail 1) and Loft > Polygons UVs like Maya, UV > Normalize on picked UVs.

The known differences listed in CHANGELOG.md still apply.

Thank you

@TMouraille made the Marking Menu Editor (#239), the Display > Polygons submenu (#240), left-aligned torn-off menus (#241) and group pivot editing (#253). @youngmin2k improved Quad Draw (#231) and fixed F framing next to other add-ons (#237). Tom Pilott sent Channel Box value dragging and the viewport extras (#224). @A2wkiller made the Outliner hide keys (#235), the lattice marking menu (#236) and the Polygon Primitives notice (#234).

Thanks for the reports and ideas: @DAI3rd (#249, #251, #252, #254), @natalietrn (#243, #244, #245, #246), @zzador (#256, #257), @coolmuzzy (#255), @gsvetlin-beep (#238), @Troyzerk (#233), @LASooner (#232), @bhowiebkr (#230), @Fizkefaaz (#212, #214, #229), @ankushinvedus-cell (#227), @Weeliano (#217, #222), @Kevorama (#223), @XeonG (#215, #216), @TheAtomicSoul (#218), @sipinglinfeng-prog (#219), @RIPTIDE-z (#197), @MarfyValarios (#250), @videopilot (#248) and @samansabz (#242). gh-5hyuns-maya-workflow-kit-for-blender.html:
0.7.0 — Smart Extrude, pivot editing, a Maya Scale manipulator, and the fixes from your reports (Blender 5.2 LTS; for Blender 4.5 LTS keep using 0.6.2)

Install it over 0.6.2, 0.6.1, 0.6.0 or 0.5.0 as usual; shelves, hotkeys, scenes and the kit's settings are kept.

Added

  • Smart Extrude (Edit Mesh > Smart Extrude, the Polygons shelf, the face marking menu): grow or carve faces inside a closed mesh; pushed through it cuts a hole, and where it meets another part of the mesh the two join, with quad walls and no extra points on straight edges, like Maya (#207).
  • Pivot editing with D: tap D (or Insert) to keep editing the pivot, click a vertex, edge or face to move the pivot there and turn it to that component; Move and Rotate follow the edited pivot (#207).
  • Make Live for several meshes at once, Prevent Negative Scale for component scaling (#207).
  • Create > Lights > Dome Light: an image-based light with a domeLight1 locator; Rotate turns the image, Intensity sets the strength (#201).
  • Snapping in the EP / CV Curve Tools and arc tools: hold X, C or V while placing or dragging a point; middle drag moves the last point (#208).
  • A preference to use Blender's navigation gizmo instead of the ViewCube (#209).

Fixed

  • The Scale manipulator works like Maya's: the centre handle scales uniformly, axis and plane handles scale along them, Ctrl+drag on an axis scales the other two (#200).
  • Graph Editor: selected objects without keys are listed, the tangent buttons have their own row, only selected keys show handles, S sets keys, F / A frame like Maya and Shift+middle drag locks to time or value (#192).
  • Bevel, Extrude and Smooth leave their Maya node in the Channel Box INPUTS, in object mode too, and a blend shape shows as blendShape1 (#204).
  • A drag off the Move / Rotate / Scale manipulator draws a marquee even when the tool's Drag setting is Tweak (#205).
  • After a Shift+drag duplicate the Outliner rows stay still and the duplicate goes last, like Maya (#217).
  • Kit windows (Hypershade, Render Settings, editors) open again at their last size and place (#203).
  • IK on chains of three or more bones splits the bend between the joints like Maya (#181); bevelling part of a cylinder cap rim gives Maya's shape (#182); two driven keys on one channel no longer show a stale value (#186).
  • Skin weights from a Maya FBX add up to 1 per vertex like Maya's own import (#189). Maya's FBX export leaves out weights of 0.001 and below; Skin > Prune Small Weights at 0.0011 before exporting keeps every weight in the file.
  • Scenes with many objects: moving, editing or selecting costs about 0.6 ms more than plain Blender (was 2.9 ms) (#191).
  • When part of Maya mode can't start, the kit takes everything back and says why, instead of leaving menus that don't open; switching back to Blender always removes the Maya menu bar (#198, #199). Commands on a hidden object warn instead of printing a Python error (#187, #196).
  • The kit's settings survive switching the add-on off and on in Preferences > Add-ons.

Changed

  • 0.7.0 is supported and tested on Blender 5.2 LTS only for now. It also installs on Blender 5.0 and 5.1, but those are not tested and may have problems. On Blender 4.5 LTS keep using 0.6.2.

The known differences listed in CHANGELOG.md still apply.

Why this exists

Many artists learned 3D in Maya and spent years building muscle memory there. When they need to work in Blender, because a team, a client, a class or a personal project uses it, that muscle memory works against them. This kit tries to make that part a little easier. It is not meant to replace Maya or to move anyone away from it; many people use both, and the kit is for the moments when you are in Blender and want your hands to feel at home.

Maya Workflow Kit is a free, personal open-source project: no paid version, no donations requested, and no commercial goal behind it.

Thank you

@youngmin2k contributed pivot editing, Prevent Negative Scale, Smart Extrude and Make Live (#207) and the hidden-mesh component-mode fix (#196). @Fizkefaaz reported the Scale manipulator (#200) and the missing INPUTS nodes (#204), @Kevorama the Tweak drag with a full analysis and test (#205), @Oxiidus the curve tool snapping (#208), @invader-zimm asked for Blender's navigation gizmo (#209), @leo2ard for the Dome Light (#201) and for kit windows that remember their size (#203), @swarnava05 reported the Graph Editor (#192), @Zhadowcode99 the menus and the switch on Blender 5.1 (#198, #199), and @Weeliano the Outliner after a Shift+drag duplicate, with a video (#217). Please keep telling us what breaks or feels off in real work.

Special thanks to @ajitta for the wonderful Claude Code skills (superclaude and know-your-unknowns) that helped us plan, build and review this release. 🙏

gh-5hyuns-maya-workflow-kit-for-blender.html:
0.6.2 — G after an extrude, switching back to Blender, and a few things from your reports (Blender 4.5 LTS – 5.2)

Install it over 0.6.1, 0.6.0 or 0.5.0 as usual; shelves, hotkeys and scenes are kept.

Fixed

  • G after an extrude: drag the extrude manipulator, select another face, press G, and it extrudes the new face like Maya. Before, G rebuilt the first extrusion (#184).
  • Switching back to Blender after starting in the Maya layout brings back your own workspaces and shows the one you had open, with no restart. Your startup file is only read, never written (#185).
  • A taller Time Slider looks like Maya's: frame numbers stay at the top in their normal size, ticks grow only in the lower part, and the current frame number stays at the bottom (#190).

  • Shift+drag on the Move / Rotate / Scale manipulator now extrudes selected vertices too, and the new vertices move with the drag. Faces and edges already worked (#183).
  • Quad Draw: hold Tab and drag a border vertex in an inner corner to fill that corner with a quad. A preview shows the new edges while you drag (#180).
  • Panels > Perspective > New makes persp1, persp2 … with the settings and starting place of the scene's persp camera, looks through it in that panel and lists it in the menu. One undo takes it back (#193).

The known differences listed in CHANGELOG.md still apply.

gh-5hyuns-maya-workflow-kit-for-blender.html:
0.6.0 — rigging that behaves like Maya 2026 (Blender 4.5 LTS – 5.2)

Joints, IK, skinning and constraints now follow Maya 2026, and a rig made in the kit reaches

Maya and game engines the way a Maya rig does.

Added

  • Joints can be moved after placement (Move tool), and Skin > Move Skinned Joints moves a bound skeleton.

  • Skinning methods Classic Linear, Dual Quaternion and Weight Blended; Bind Skin gets Maya's options.

  • Spline IK Twist and Roll, constraint Interp Type, every Aim world up type.

  • Four View as four real panels, each with its own shading, Show menu and camera.

  • UV Shell selection in the 3D View and the UV Editor; UV Automatic keeps its history node.

  • Game Exporter as a window that stays open; Rigify rigs export only their deforming joints with Maya-safe names.

  • Animation layers on joints, and in-between blend shapes written as Maya blendShape in-betweens.

Changed

  • Orient Joint, IK RP (default pole vector, twist), skin commands and pick walk give Maya 2026's results.

  • Cylinder, Extrude and Bevel number vertices and faces like Maya; keys get Maya 2026's auto tangents.

  • Step Snap is kept per tool; wrong selections print Maya's own error messages.

  • Hotkeys, shelves and Graph Editor / Dope Sheet menus follow Maya 2026.

Fixed

  • Shift+drag on the manipulator runs Smart Duplicate / Smart Extrude again.

  • Hotbox menu-name clicks no longer run a menu item; a held Space keeps the hotbox up.

  • UV Editor freezes and a crash when moving UVs on large meshes.

  • Top menus not responding right after install; install error on Python 3.14 builds of Blender.

  • Rigify controls keep Pose mode; Selection Highlighting can be turned off; the D pivot grabs the manipulator at once.

Upgrade

  • Install over 0.5.0 as usual; shelves, hotkeys and scenes are kept. Disabling and re-enabling the extension resets

    its own preferences (Blender drops add-on preferences on disable), so note custom settings first.

Known differences

  • IK RP on chains of 3 or more bones: the middle joints bend slightly differently from Maya (2-bone chains match) (#181).

  • Bevelling only part of a cylinder cap rim gives a different shape from Maya (whole rims match) (#182).

  • Dual Quaternion skinning with a scaled joint scales about the bone, Maya about the origin.

  • Pose Space Deformation blends each pose linearly; overlapping poses differ from Maya.

  • Motion path roll on 3D paths can differ from Maya by a few degrees.

  • Set Driven Key with two drivers on a Translate / Rotate channel can show a stale value for one update now and then;

    the next change fixes it (#186).

gh-5hyuns-maya-workflow-kit-for-blender.html:
0.5.0 — the animation chain, Maya 2026 menus and Maya's editors (Blender 4.5 LTS – 5.2)

Added

  • Rig controls from NURBS curves: parent a curve shape to a joint, with Maya's wireframe colours.
  • Constraints with several weighted targets, Set Driven Key with Maya's tangents, IK / FK switching.
  • Blend shapes with in-betweens, combinations and corrective shapes; Pose Space Deformation with a Pose Editor.
  • Paint Skin Weights shows weight numbers on the vertices and follows Maya 2026's tool settings.
  • Rigs go to Maya and back through FBX with matching joints, skin and keys.
  • Quaternion bones show Rotate X / Y / Z and key with S.
  • Game Exporter clips, Motion Trail Editor, Attach to Motion Path and Flow Path Object.
  • Preferences window and Hotkey Editor; Component, Shape, Connection and Reference Editors.
  • More Graph Editor, animation layer, UV Editor, Curves and Deform commands; Ambient and Volume lights.
  • Joints feel like Maya objects: click a joint to pick it, live Channel Box while dragging, a Paint Skin Weights workspace (contributed by @cnzim).

Changed

  • Menus follow Maya 2026.
  • Bake Simulation and the Joint Tool behave like Maya 2026.
  • Renders match Maya's brightness; new scenes have Maya's startup cameras and names.

Fixed

  • Snapping works again after turning Step Snap off.
  • Right-click marking-menu flicks pick the right item everywhere in the view.
  • Animation layer keys show in the Channel Box and Graph Editor.

Known limits

  • Pose Space Deformation blends each pose linearly; overlapping poses differ from Maya.
  • Motion path roll on 3D paths can differ from Maya by a few degrees.
  • In-between shapes reach game engines as plain shape keys.
  • On Blender 5.1, Cycles renders Maya Ambient and Volume lights too dark; use Blender 4.5, 5.2 or EEVEE for them.

🙏 Thank you, testers!

A big thank-you to everyone who tried the kit in real work and took the time to report what broke. Your reports shaped this release:

Please keep the reports coming. Every issue gets read 😊

gh-5hyuns-maya-workflow-kit-for-blender.html:
A bug-fix and store-compliance release. Blender 4.5 LTS to 5.2.

Thank you to everyone who tried the kit in real work and reported what felt wrong. Most of the fixes below come from those reports.

Changed
  • Nothing outside the add-on changes any more. No theme is shipped or applied, Blender preferences and your keymap are never written (Maya keys are add-on keymap items that go away when Maya mode or the add-on is off), and no files are copied into your scripts folder. Disabling or removing the add-on undoes everything.
  • Scripts from the Command Line, Script Editor and Python shelf buttons now run through Blender's own Run Script.
  • Recommended theme and navigation settings are listed in the description instead of being applied.
  • New icons for the shelves, Status Line, panel toolbar, Tool Box, Layer Editor, Outliner and about 190 menu items, drawn after Maya's look and sharp at 100 / 125 / 150 % UI scale.
  • Hypershade opens as its own window in Maya's layout: Browser, Create, Material Viewer, Graph and Property Editor.
Fixed
  • Soft Select: middle-mouse drag changes the radius, it is off by default, affected vertices are coloured, and it is shared between object and component mode.
  • Primitives (polygon and NURBS) show their INPUTS in the Channel Box (Radius, Subdivisions...) and use Maya's topology, such as cylinder cap fans.
  • Channel Box: drag over fields to select several channels and type one value for all of them.
  • Double-click loop selection, and "pick two, select the run between" for edges, vertices and faces.
  • Multi-Cut works like Maya's, and tools have Maya Tool Settings; double-clicking a Tool Box icon opens them.
  • Auto Key button, and key ticks on the Time Slider.
  • F frames with the camera you are looking through; Single Perspective shows the perspective view.
  • Viewport panel toolbar buttons and the UV Editor checker turn off again.
  • Material colour changes show in shaded mode.
  • Marking menus no longer close while dragging or over the Time Slider.
  • Torn-off panels open at a size that fits their content; Hide / Show work in torn-off menus.
  • Layer Editor rows, buttons and icons follow Maya.
  • Ctrl+D, Delete History and Edit menu items work in component mode.
  • Paint Skin Weights normalizes weights like Maya.
  • Visibility (h, Channel Box Visibility, display layers) stays in sync.
  • Switching back to Blender leaves no empty Maya panels.
  • Ctrl+N opens a new scene in the Maya layout.
  • Fixed a crash when closing an editor window right after opening it from a Maya menu.
Install

Download maya-workflow-kit-0.2.1.zip below, then in Blender: Edit > Preferences > Get Extensions > ⌄ > Install from Disk. Use the -legacy zip only for the classic add-on installer.

Closed issues: https://github.com/5hyuns/maya-workflow-kit-for-blender/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed

bforartists.html:
Rotation and Dopesheet Gizmo Stability Release 🧭

This is a cumulative point release focused on stability and polish, with a couple of new gizmo core features: roll the view by dragging a gizmo, and interactive scene strips in the Dopesheet.

This release is built on Blender 5.3.0 Alpha (Blender main as of October 7, 2026), with 76 new features, fixes and polish from us since 5.2.0.

✨What's new in this release:
  • View Roll gizmo — Drag left or right on the navigation gizmo to roll the view, with an angle indicator while you drag. Roll controls and a hotkey are also in the 3D View sidebar
  • Dopesheet Scene Strip gizmos — Interactive gizmos to edit scene strips directly in the Dopesheet and timeline frame ranges with a gesture
  • Sequencer and Timeline — Ripple Delete, lasso select hotkeys like the other editors, consolidated keyframing tools in the Timeline footers, and consistent frame range icons
  • 30+ new node icons — New Geometry Nodes, Shader Light nodes and Compositor nodes now have icons and toolshelf entries, including Comment, XPBD Solver, Construct Curves, Rasterize Points, Grid Solve Poisson, Combine List and Bundle nodes
  • Cleaner menus — Removed double entries (Import FBX, Link to Scene, Snap, Implicit Conversion), Show/Hide submenus in Pose and Weight Paint, and toolshelves that follow the Add menu order
  • Bigger splashscreen with more recent files
  • Easier extensions — Installing and removing legacy pre-downloaded extensions is simpler, and the Asset Libraries filter now has an icon
  • Clearer themes — Node highlights stand out more, and curve handle colors now more legible
🧡 Top Usability Features from Blender 5.3 (Alpha):
  • Sidebar Search — Find any property or operator in any editor's sidebar, including add-on tabs
  • Custom Outliner Sorting — Arrange objects anywhere in the Outliner
  • Comment Node — Annotate node trees, with Markdown formatting
  • Ripple Editing in the Sequencer — Ripple, Shuffle and Overwrite overlap modes (R, S, V), Ripple Trim and Ripple Delete
  • OpenTimelineIO — Import and export edits to and from other editing software
  • Smarter Scene Strips — Scene strips update their length on their own, and many datablocks can be dropped straight onto the timeline
  • Compositor Effects Stack and Bundle nodes — Effects organized as a stack, with grouped data handling
  • EEVEE Material Lighting Nodes and Panoramic Cameras — Toon shading and lighting effects, plus equirectangular, fisheye and mirror ball cameras
  • Geometry Nodes for Volumes and Curves — Rasterize Points, Poisson Solver and Construct Curves
  • Convert Rotation Mode for Animation — Convert keyframes between rotation modes with Ctrl+R

And many more bug fixes and more!

Note: Bforartists follows Blender main, so this release carries Blender 5.3 Alpha code. Files stay fully compatible with Blender. Bforartists 5.3, built on the final Blender 5.3, follows on November 10.

bforartists.html:
Cumulative Refinement Release ⚒️

This is a point release with much work on performance, stability and polish.

This is part of the latest from Blender 5.2.0 and 5.3.0 to the date - with 56 new features from us.

⚠️ Mac builds coming soon

✨What's new in this release:
  • Improved default size for the Node Minimap
  • Geometry Nodes Mesh Bevel Node, Sort Lists node, Grease Pencil Read nodes, Closure to Lists node, and NURBS Order and Weight nodes
  • Expose UV move on axis operators to top level
  • Library operators to open preferences tab, open and clear download Cache
  • Other refinements to Sequencer, Properties Editor, Outliner, Smart Delete, Compositor, and more
🧡 Top Usability Features from Blender 5.2 and 5.3:

From 5.2.0:

  • Node-Based Physics (XPBD Solver) — Brand new procedural hair & cloth simulations with customizable constraints
  • Mesh Bevel Node — Long-awaited procedural edge/vertex bevel control in Geometry Nodes
  • Online Asset Libraries — Dozens of materials, HDRs, and node groups downloadable on demand
  • EEVEE Screen Space Raytracing Overhaul — Backface tracing, reduced banding, faster GI, and major stability fixes
  • Cycles Texture Cache — Automatic optimized textures, drastically reducing memory usage
  • Grease Pencil Delaunay Fill — Exact geometry fill with gap detection, inverse filling, and faster performance
  • Playback Loop Modes — Infinite, Stop at End/Start, Bounce, and Restore Frame modes
  • Sculpt Add Primitive Tool — Drop cubes, cones, spheres directly into sculpts
  • Compositor Gizmo Auto Keying — Transform gizmos auto-insert keyframes in backdrop & Image Editor
  • Thin Wall Mode (Principled BSDF) — Physically accurate thin materials (paper, leaves, glass)

From 5.3.0 (Alpha):

  • Vulkan Default Renderer — Vulkan backend now default on Windows & Linux; hardware ray traced shadows in Workbench
  • Compositor Playback Caching — Interactive compositor caches playback; up to 2x faster GPU performance
  • Sequencer Ripple Delete — Auto-close gaps when deleting strips (Shift+X)
  • Sequencer Strip Thumbnails — Scene, Text, Mask and MovieClip strips now show thumbnails in timeline
  • Sculpt Automasking in Vertex/Weight Paint — Topology, boundary, cavity, and normal masking support
  • Animation Scrubbing Pauses Playback — Scrubbing now pauses playback, resumes on release
  • Node Editor Link Highlighting — Highlight links through reroute nodes for clearer node trees
  • Sculpt Transform Only Pivot — Control pivot placement with transform gizmo without affecting geometry
  • Outliner Scroll to New Collection — Auto-scroll and auto-rename newly added collections
  • Improved Brushes & Weight Paint Defaults — Updated essential brushes, better defaults, and Cut Curves hair brush

And many more bug fixes and more!

To fix, close all editors with the broken asset shelf, respawn the editor and it will be fixed. Then save the startup.

This release is focused on new Compositor assets that come out of the box, new smart asset updates and apply operators, and much much love to the node editors.

This is part of all the latest from Blender 5.0.0 and 5.1.0 to the date - with 242 new tokens of love from us and a large chunk also from Blender!

⚠️ Warning: *.Blend File formats from this version onwards will not be backwards compatible with earlier versions of Blender 4.5.x or Bforartists 4.4.x. It's a one way trip!

What's new:
  • 99 new Compositor assets, including shapes, patterns, lens effects, color adjustments, filters and more
  • New customizable colored backgrounds on nodes
  • New icons in collapsed icon headers
  • New customizable Node Editor Overlay for canvas center
  • Enhanced Asset Shelf user experience: New packed mode, and love to context menu operators for Armature Pose assets
  • Group Operators in Node Toolshelf: Node group operators moved to toolshelf for better accessibility
  • New icons for frames with new frame operators
  • New Apply operators: Apply with remesh, join, and boolean on selected meshes with one click
  • Presentation Addon Enhancement: New Slides operator for presentations
  • Interface Consistency Improvements: more robust columns for tabbed toolshelf
  • Region Toggle Pie Menu: Added to T key and exposed in header
  • Organized Node categories and groups for less bloat and better discoverability
  • New Animation Timeline Footers and Dopesheet editor mode
  • New quick toggle to Timeline with the Power User Tools
  • Consistent paint curve dropdowns in header and sidebar for jitter and pressure settings
  • Update to the Curves edit mode to be consistent with other modes
  • Adopted the new Blender "Built-in" sequencer scene sync with our legacy 3D Sequencer system with timeline gizmos
  • New Geometry Nodes assets and modifiers from Blender adopted to the Bforartists asset shelves
  • Smart Mesh Blend by Proximity assets gets material blending, performance modes, and an improved wizard user experience

Additional Features from this Blender 5.0.x and 5.1.x series:

  • Improved UV user experience with sync
  • New Compositor Sequencer Mode: New Sequencer modifier with access to using compositor nodes with Sequence Info strip integration
  • Minimized Theme Panel Visual Update
  • Frame Jump is now built into the timeline with seconds and frames
  • Geometry Nodes Improvements: Multiple new Grid, SDF, and Volume nodes
  • Performance Optimizations: Improved tessellation, subdivision, and general performance
  • New Radial Tiling vector node
  • New Repeat Zone for Shaders (with bundles and closures)
  • New & Updated MatCaps: optional specular lighting in MatCaps improves shading clarity, especially on dark surfaces.
  • Dope Sheet Cache Visualization – Clearer feedback on cached frames for animation performance monitoring.
  • Video Sequencer Overhaul: Dedicated Strip and Strip Modifiers tabs with drag-and-drop modifier stacks, icons, and search.
  • Multi-Scene Sequencer Workflows – Sequencer can now reference different scenes, with Sync Scene Time for seamless editing.
  • Grease Pencil Motion Blur: Adds natural blur to strokes with adjustable steps, enhancing animation quality.
  • Grease Pencil Corner Types: Per-point corner styles (Round, Sharp, Flat) for more precise stroke design.
  • Faster cycles and EEVEE
  • Netter Subsurface scattering, volumetrics and multi-scattering
  • New sky mode for environments
  • Faster unwrapping and field evaluation in Geometry Nodes
  • Better FBX, Alembix and USD compatibility
  • Adaptive subdivision in Cycles now official
  • Metallic Thin Film Iridescence for Cycles

And much much more

bforartists.html:
Hotfix for Colored Collection Rows Release

This is a hotfix and commulative stability release with 7 show-stopper bug fixes, including the missing Last Operator panel, HIP support, and theme saving.

This is part of an exciting release with all the latest from Blender 4.3 and 4.4 to the date - with a chunk of 176 pieces of love from us this cycle.

What's new with the 4.3 series!

Additionally includes:

  • Horizontal walk navigation lock
  • Smarter Smart delete in Mesh Edit mode (removes isolated geometry now)
  • New Colored Collection Rows highlights
  • New Grease Pencil Nodegroups in the Default Library
  • New Silhouette toggle for the 3D View with the Power User Tools
  • New Asset Shelf category defaults and tag filtering, with additional thumbnail quick size buttons
  • Refined Grease Pencil 3 interface and UX
  • General maintenance, details, tooltips and refinement to everything new coming in from Blender

Included new features from Blender are:

  • New editing of Text Strips in the Preview of the Sequencer editor
  • New Geometry Nodes: Find in String, Collection and Object Input
  • New Geometry Nodes "For Each" zone, Grease Pencil nodes, and much more
  • New method to swap and resize areas
  • New Metal BSDF
  • Videos can now render in 10bit
  • New Animation Slots to assign multiple objects to the same Action Clip
  • And much more
  • And much more.

The binary downloads can as usual also be found in the download section of the official webpage. https://www.bforartists.de/download/ And the release note is here: https://www.bforartists.de/release-notes/

Bforartists 3 Version 3.0.1 comes with all the bugfixes from Blender 3.0.1. Blender 3.0.1. has fixed over 80 bugs.

One of the last big projects in Bforartists is fulfilled. All text and properties are now left aligned in the modifiers too. The experimental keymap with F to center at the view and X C V to adjust the brushes is now the main keymap. As a reminder, here you can find a pdf file with the vital changes in the new keymap: https://www.bforartists.de/data/tuts/experimental_changes.pdf

The rest is the usual work to keep Bforartists updated with the Blender changes. Align all the new middle alignend things left in the UI, create new icons, fix oddities. All in all we have around 110 changes in this release.

This release ends the current development cycle. Our design goals for Bforartists are largely met. And we fade slowly into a maintaining development status to keep our changes stable, consistent and up to date with Blender. But we won't stop to make Bforartists better and better.

As with every release, friends, It was me a pleasure to work with you. And many thanks to our users too for supporting us!

Have fun with the new version. Enjoy Bforartists :) Reiner

bforartists.html:
Hello Friends,

We have a new version of Bforartists ready, Version 3.0.0.

The binary downloads can as usual also be found in the download section of the official webpage. https://www.bforartists.de/download/ And the release note can be found here: https://www.bforartists.de/release-notes/

Bforartists 3 Version 3.0.0 comes with all the changes from Blender 3. And lots of improvements for Bforartists. The constraints have now left aligned text too. The Ui and tooltips got further streamlined. The tabs in the tool shelf are now in other editors available too. The toolbar has some new entries. We have around 200 new icons for the geometry nodes editor. And all these nodes in the sidebar available. The asset browser has its first own workspace. We added some more matcaps. And a ton of small improvements and fixes. The small changes always makes the masses of the changes. A little improvement here, a little improvement there ...

All in all it's around 340 changes in this release. Not every change is a change at the source code. We needed to fix github actions for example. This was also a very time consuming task. Github actions is the test compile to check if there are some problems in the source code.

We have also a new experimental keymap with some vital changes regarding the brushes handling. The brushes hotkeys moved from F, in combination with holding ctrl, shift and alt, to X C V keys. And F is now Frame selected. No need anymore to release the mouse and press numpad 0 to put the selection in focus. Please test this new keymap for conflicts. These changes will most probably go into the main keymap with the next point release.

Bforartists is a fork of the popluar open source 3D software Blender. With the goal to improve the graphical UI and usability.

As with every release, and even more with this yet another milestone release, i want again to thank everybody involved for your support and help and passion for this project. It was me a pleasure :)

Have fun with the new version - Reiner

gh-holdmybeer-gg-blenderwright.html:
blenderwright 3.1: tested in real Blender

Every tool now has a test that runs against a real Blender 5.2 on Linux and Windows on every pull request. Writing that suite found and fixed bugs that the old mocked tests missed.

New tools
  • Animation: drivers with Python-free expressions, keyframe any animatable property, actions, NLA strips and F-curve modifiers.
  • Rigging: bone collections, IK chains, and more constraints.
  • Physics: force fields, colliders, soft bodies, rigid body constraints and world settings.
  • Drawing: Grease Pencil v3 strokes and Line Art, plus Freestyle for ink line renders.
  • Modelling: lattices, metaballs, edit_mesh_operation, and geometry node trees built in one call, zones included.
  • Sculpting: masks and face sets.
  • Assets and files: asset libraries (list and place), linked data (make local, override, reload), external paths, pack and unpack, and per-format export options.
  • Scene: view layers, light groups and shader AOVs, the working colour space, units, colour attributes, UV map management, and sequencer strips with fades.
  • 30 more shader nodes and 13 more modifiers.
Server
  • Optional "Start with Blender" in the N-panel.
  • One token per port, so two Blenders can each run a server.
  • A reply that can't be encoded returns an error instead of dropping the connection.
Fixes

UV tools from edit mode, select_by_axis halves, focus_on_object in sculpt and edit mode, add_geometry_node, threaded shafts are now watertight, and convert_object keeps the object's name. get_object_info reports world_location and up-to-date dimensions, and get_node_tree reports node values and settings.

gh-holdmybeer-gg-blenderwright.html:
blenderwright 3.0: built for Blender 5.2 LTS

Breaking: requires Blender 5.2 LTS. Update the add-on and the MCP server together.

Fixed on Blender 5.2

Six tools failed on 5.2 and now work: geometry node inputs, sculpt brushes, keyframe interpolation and listing, physics baking, Minimum Stretch unwrapping (formerly SLIM), and image output after a video render. Also fixed: selected-only export for every format, choosing Cycles or Workbench, the render-busy guard, assign_material on single-material objects, and viewport capture restoring your render settings.

Security
  • The socket is authenticated with a challenge-response handshake. The token never crosses the socket, and every command is signed and numbered, so nothing can be injected, altered or replayed.
  • The MCP server sends nothing to a process on the port that cannot prove it is Blender.
  • On Windows the port is claimed exclusively.
New tools (about 40)
  • Finished look: colour management (AgX, looks, exposure), compositor effects (glare, vignette, film grain and 17 more), denoising, Cycles sampling and light paths, motion blur, render passes, ray visibility and shadow catcher, light linking, EEVEE quality, render performance.
  • Light: Blender's built-in HDRIs, HDRI rotation, and a physically based procedural sky.
  • Modelling: Essentials node modifiers (array, scatter on surface, curve to tube and more), symmetrize, bisect, and loop tools (circle, space evenly, flatten).
  • Deformation: vertex groups and weight operations, and shape keys you can sculpt, blend and animate.
  • Game assets: texture baking including high-poly to low-poly normal maps, UV island operations, and texel density.
  • Reuse: list, link and append from other .blend files, plus collection instances.
Removed

Collada and X3D, which Blender 5 no longer ships, and SVG export, which never worked.

What's Changed

  • Target Blender 5.2 LTS; fix six tools broken on it by @jabberwock in https://github.com/HoldMyBeer-gg/blenderwright/pull/75
  • capture_viewport restores render settings when the render fails by @jabberwock in https://github.com/HoldMyBeer-gg/blenderwright/pull/76
  • Armature handlers reject a missing name by @jabberwock in https://github.com/HoldMyBeer-gg/blenderwright/pull/78
  • Add Blender 5.2 API stubs for the editor by @jabberwock in https://github.com/HoldMyBeer-gg/blenderwright/pull/77
  • Authenticate socket commands with a per-start token by @jabberwock in https://github.com/HoldMyBeer-gg/blenderwright/pull/79
  • Add set_color_management and set_film by @jabberwock in https://github.com/HoldMyBeer-gg/blenderwright/pull/80
  • assign_material replaces an object's only material by @jabberwock in https://github.com/HoldMyBeer-gg/blenderwright/pull/81
  • Add denoising, Cycles sampling, light paths, motion blur and render passes by @jabberwock in https://github.com/HoldMyBeer-gg/blenderwright/pull/82
  • Render guard works on Blender 5.2 by @jabberwock in https://github.com/HoldMyBeer-gg/blenderwright/pull/83
  • Add compositor tools: glare, vignette, film grain and more by @jabberwock in https://github.com/HoldMyBeer-gg/blenderwright/pull/84
  • render_settings toolset; enable_toolset shows the whole menu by @jabberwock in https://github.com/HoldMyBeer-gg/blenderwright/pull/85

blender-launcher.html:
What's Changed

🛠️ Fixes:

  • Fix a crash in the onboarding window on first launch
  • Fix the new builds check timer overflowing when the check interval was set above 596 hours. The maximum interval is now 596 hours, and higher saved values are lowered to it automatically
  • Version search query error messages are now localized

gh-ucupumar-ucupaint.title: Ucupaint 3.0.0
gh-ucupumar-ucupaint.summary: ⭐ What's New So many new things in this release warrant skipping 2.5 and going straight to 3.0. 🔸 Cleaner UI and a base layer The new UI focuses more on the layer list, so all other panels are hidden under panels or popover buttons by default. A Base Layer is…
gh-ucupumar-ucupaint.html:
⭐ What's New

So many new things in this release warrant skipping 2.5 and going straight to 3.0.

🔸 Cleaner UI and a base layer

The new UI focuses more on the layer list, so all other panels are hidden under panels or popover buttons by default. A Base Layer is also automatically created to edit the base value of all the channels.
New UI popover buttons
🔸 New Height and Vector Displacement Channel

Originally part of the normal channel, height (previously bump) and vector displacement are now their own channel. This simplifies the implementation a lot and opens many possibilities for further improvements. By default, The height channel output is still used as extra bumps on normal channel, so the way you work with ucupaint is still the same.

The Diplacement Setup toggle is also replaced with Quick Displacement Setup operator. The function is still the same, which is to enable displacement and subdivide the meshes to a certain number of polygons, but since it's now an operator, you can do it multiple times to check whether the number of polygons is already enough for your meshes.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8c00574f-30c9-49f0-81fc-c16a57fb009f

🔸 Unified Preview Mode

Previously, channels and layers had their own preview mode, version 3.0 unifies this into a single preview mode that can be used to preview a channel, a layer, layer alpha, mask, or custom data.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e2c31fdd-474b-42d1-ade0-06020e9921bd

🔸 Adjustment layer

You can now add an adjustment layer, which is just a layer with the previous layer's data that you can add modifiers to.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e34b567c-3c77-4646-8e1b-0a4c6ddf5659

🔸 Spherical and Cylindrical decal

New decal types are added: spherical and cylindrical. Contributed by @lsmine0
Cylindrical Decal Demo Spherical Decal Demo
🔸 Bake Target Refactor

A channel now requires a bake target before it can be baked. This allows you to customize settings such as the name, resolution, and other options independently. Don't worry about creating one manually, as a bake target is automatically generated whenever you create a channel. By default, it uses the settings you specify when you do Bake Ucupaint Node (formerly Bake All Channels).

This new bake target system also makes it possible to just use ORM as your main bake target and also you use color attribute as bake target.
Bake Target popover menu contains all the bake targets and Bake Ucupaint Node button Using ORM is now an option when you do Quick Ucupaint Node Setup Color attribute is now available to use when creating new bake target
🔸 New Icon

Ucupaint has a new icon contributed by @trulybeardless
New Icon New Icon in Blender compact sidebar tabs
🔸 Other changes
  • Vector is renamed to Mapping
  • Legacy Smoother Bump is now gone, your file will be converted to the new system if you load old files using Ucupaint 3.0

UI Performance Optimization

This version includes performance optimization for UI drawing, which can be five times faster in some cases, especially on complex layer setups. This meant navigating Ucupaint UI will be less laggy. More improvements are still coming for future versions.

Sponsors Panel Update

More tier members are now visible by default, and all icons are consistently aligned to the left. Support Ucupaint if you also want your name and icons to be included in this list.

Bugfixes

  • Fix: Cannot use Use Layer Vector option for mask.

gh-ucupumar-ucupaint.html:
New Features

  • Dedicated alpha channel (Demo)
  • Decal constraint option to make decal objects stick to the surface (Demo)
  • Open layer from Ucupaint material asset (Example)
  • "Smoothness" suffix in the file name is now detectable for loading images to a single layer.
  • Other object color baking is now available for creating a mask.
  • Mirror modifier will be temporarily applied when sculpting VDM images if Mirror U/V is enabled. This will make it possible to sculpt at the mirrored mesh.
  • New operator in the normal channel cog wheel button to apply all VDM layers to multires modifier.
  • OSL option is now available for layer/mask baking.
  • New option to add Ambient Occlusion channel after Quick Setup.
  • New option to use transparency for missing ray in other object normal baking.
  • Layer alpha is now selectable as the layer channel source.

UI Updates

  • New sponsors panel to show Ucupaint supporters and the goal (Demo)
  • Info panel now shows contributor icons.
  • Both sponsors' and contributors' data are updated once per day.
  • There will be a button to switch to material view when the user is in solid/wireframe viewport.
  • There will be a warning message when creating realtime AO/Edge Detect layer/mask, which mentions that the rendered/baked result can be different
  • Active channel name will be visible when the main channels list is collapsed and layer preview mode is enabled.
  • Material-specific options like render method/alpha blending are now moved to the new material dropdown.
Info panel now shows contributor icons Ucupaint sponsors will be shown in the sponsors panel New material dropdown for material related settings

Performance Improvements

  • Less lag when doing a transformation operation while Ucupaint UI is open.
  • Less lag when changing Ucupaint UI sliders.
  • Faster native VDM baking for Blender 5.0
  • Faster VDM baking since all unrelated objects are automatically hidden while baking.

Changes

  • Background layer and alpha toggle are no longer available to use since the functionality is already covered by a dedicated alpha channel.
  • Baking other object data now will hide the source objects after baking (It can be changed in the bake dialog box and there’s a button to unhide the source objects).
  • Baking fake lighting will use a 32-bit float image by default for better gradient (Blender 2.80+)
  • Vertex Color is now called Color Attributes in Blender 3.2+ to match Blender convention.
  • Open Available Image renamed to Open Existing Image
  • Smooth bump will be enabled by default, but only for Blender 2.76 and 2.77, since it’s the only way to make the bump map visible in the viewport.
  • Loading material assets is now only available for Blender 4.0+ since it returns an error in earlier versions.

Bugfixes

  • Blender built-in icons are now used whenever possible to avoid missing icons.
  • Fix: Baking channel with multiple objects can cause some objects to have wrong color when there is missing vertex color data
  • Fix: Sculpting VDM image with Flip Y/Z disabled produces a wrong mesh
  • Fix: Baking mask to image returns an error if the active object is hidden in the viewport.
  • Fix: Blender 5.0 doesn’t create an output node by default, which is causing an error.
  • Fix: Cannot bake layer/mask with blur enabled in Blender 5.0
  • Fix: In certain cases, Refresh Linear Color Space button can appear and cannot be removed
  • Fix: Toggling the eraser on custom brush with Erase Alpha blending sometimes can cause an error
  • Fix: User can mistakenly open color ID attribute as a layer/mask.
  • Fix: Removing a layer does not remove its baked image masks
  • Fix: Baking mask to image with preview mode enabled sometimes can disconnect the preview node.
  • Fix: Animation playback causes errors on Blender 5.0
  • Fix: Wrong default value when baking custom bake target if there’s no layer using the channel
  • Fix: Cannot register addon when updater JSON is empty
  • Fix: Bake other object extrusion and ray settings are not available to access when Use Cage is disabled.

Note

Ucupaint 2.4.0 still supports all Blender versions from Blender 2.76, so no worries for anyone who still uses older hardware/software

Changes

  • Opening other layer image/vertex color as a mask no longer automatically set the source input to Alpha since the user doesn't always want to use the image as an alpha clip.
  • Using Enable Baked Outside and Displacement Setup will use the combined normal as the final normal rather than the normal without bump. gh-ucupumar-ucupaint.html:
This release includes a significant UI redesign that aims to resolve some of the previous UI issues.

Updated UI

Collapsible Group

It's now possible to collapse a layer group

New dropdown icons

Dropdownable UI panels now have distinct arrow icons and are easier to click.

Layer channel source

Previously you needed to enable override toggle (hidden by default) to change layer channel value, now you can just change the layer channel source.

Other UI changes
  • Vector option is now outside of layer dropdown
  • Use lock icon toggle for Uniform Scale
  • Object index is now consistently labeled Object index instead of Pass Index
  • Layer and mask sources are now directly integrated into the UI
  • Experimental display list option to make mask/override images to have their own entries on the layer list
  • Rebake button is added beside Use Baked button
  • Blender 2.7x also has an updated UI, but the dropdown area is still the icon only (icon label can't be clicked)

Changes

  • Preview mode is now will disable compositor by default since it can change the actual color (#238)
  • Toggle Eraser on texture paint mode in Blender 4.3+ won't create a new brush but select the available eraser brush asset
  • Smoother Bump option is now only available if the experimental option is enabled since it's been deprecated (It's still available by default for Blender 2.7x)

Support

Ucupaint 2.2 still supports all Blender versions from Blender 2.76, so no worries for anyone who still uses older hardware/software

  • Fix: Images won't autosave when using EXR format (#232)
  • Fix: Manually created UDIM images sometimes don't get packed correctly (#237)

  • Fix: Move layer in or out of group can't be undo-ed

  • Fix: Missing UI when other objects bake data are not found
  • Fix: Toggle eraser is not working on Blender 4.4
  • Fix: Manipulating main channels can cause wrong keyframed/driver data

This is supposed to be a maintenance release of Ucupaint, but thanks to many PRs from @passivestar, it also has a lot of new quality-of-life features ✨

New features

  • New operator to set position decal to 3d cursor (#179)
  • New image menu to Save an Image Copy
New modern icons on Ucupaint 2.1.1

Changes

  • Decal object will use the same collection as the parent object
  • SSAA is disabled by default for baking other objects' data since it will quadruple the memory usage

Bugfixes

  • Fix: Load material images scans all asset files in the asset browser, which can cause errors and slowdown (#167)
  • Fix: Duplicate Ucupaint Node can cause the original node to have multiple users
  • Fix: Opening an already existing image from disk won’t use the available image

  • Fix: Save as Image Copy option does not work
  • Fix: Load images from material does not scan images inside node groups
  • Fix: Cannot properly load ‘Metalness’ image to ‘Metallic’ channel

New features

  • Decal mapping (#37) (Demo)

  • Lower the Blender requirements to Blender 2.76

Changes

  • Custom bake target will always use Non-Color colorspace since Blender has a problem showing individual R/G/B channels on image editor if it’s an sRGB image.
  • When loading images to a single layer, if a bump and normal map are found at the same time, only the bump map will be used by default since most PBR textures have the exact effect between their bump and normal map.
  • Use Displacement Only mode when enabling displacement setup since it produces better displacement on cycles while not affecting Eevee.
  • Ucupaint UI will still be accessible when you use Hydra Storm render engine for testing purpose.

Bugfixes

  • Fix: UDIM is not detected automatically when rebaking layer
  • Fix: Preview mode does not work with normal map layer

  • Fix: Renaming channel did not rename some of normal input output names
