gh-blenderkit-blendkit.summary: We are thrilled to announce the latest updates and enhancements to BlenderKit! Our team has been working diligently to bring you new features and bug fixes in BlenderKit v3.9.0.231123 that will improve your experience and workflow. Whether you're a seasoned…
gh-blenderkit-blendkit.html:
We are thrilled to announce the latest updates and enhancements to BlenderKit! Our team has been working diligently to bring you new features and bug fixes in BlenderKit v3.9.0.231123 that will improve your experience and workflow. Whether you're a seasoned professional or just starting out, these updates are designed to streamline your creative process, making it more intuitive, efficient, and enjoyable. Dive into what's new and discover how these changes can elevate your projects. Let's explore these exciting developments together!

Here's what's new:

🔽 Folding of BlenderKit Menu in 3D Viewport - Arrow button was added to the left of the BlenderKit menu in 3D Viewport. By using this button you can fold/hide the BlenderKit menu and then unfold/show it again. Have the maximum of your viewport while keeping the BlenderKit search just one click away! Details

🌟 Added Other Category - For the uploads you are now able to select "Other..." in every subcategory and sub-subcategory. Please be aware that choosing appropriate category, subcategory and/or sub-subcategory helps the other users to find your asset efectively. However if you feel there is really no fitting (sub-)subcategory, you are free to choose the "Other..." option. Details

🚫 Cancel the Download by ESC - You can cancel the download of asset by pressing ESC button. We all know that feeling when we change our minds just a millisecond after dropping an asset into a scene. No more fumbling around in the N-Panel to delete the download, no more waiting for the download and then deleting the asset. Just press ESC. Details

🧐 Search by License - You can now filter assets by their license type (Royalty Free, Creative Commons Zero) to make sure you only get results that fully match the requirements of your project. Details

🔧 Persistent Add-on Preferences: We've introduced a persistent add-on preferences config. Navigate to the add-on preferences and enable the "Keep preferences on disabling" option. Once enabled, the add-on preferences will save to a config JSON file when the add-on is disabled and reload when it's enabled. By default, this option is off, so the add-on aligns with Blender's philosophy: once disabled, all configuration is forgotten. Now, the choice is yours on what best fits your workflow! Details

🎨 ACES thumbnails with correct brightness: The add-on can now automatically detect the ACES colorspace (if configured manually through the replacement of the colorspace directory). This update rectifies the overexposed asset thumbnails in the GUI. A fix for other possible ACES configurations (through different add-ons) is on its way. Details

Bug fixes & Updates:

🛠️ Fix Material Uploads in Blender 4 - Due to a change in the Blender 4 API, some material uploads were failing. This minor bug was missed in our pre-release testing of Blender 4, so we are fixing it in the next release as soon as possible after it was reported. So we can again happily say: we fully support Blender 4. And of cource the Blender 3 support remains a given certainty. Details

🖌️ Fixed Brush Categories not Showing - We've fixed a bug where brush categories weren't displayed outside of sculpting or image paint modes. Details

📺 Updated Video in Welcome Window - We've updated the video tutorial link in the add-on's welcome window to a new tutorial for Blender 3.6LTS. Details

🔕 Prevented object_print3d_utils Warning Message - Users without enabled object_print3d_utils were shown a warning message in the log console. We've modified the use of object_print3d_utils so that this warning message doesn't bother you when you look at the Blender log console. Details

👀 Indicating Unavailable Thumbnails - Small thumbs will now clearly indicate if an asset's thumbnail is unavailable. Details

🔧 Fix Rare Problem of Unavailable Thumbnails - In some very rare cases the thumbnails of non-validated assets were failing for out validators. To improve validator's experience and by that improving the validation speed and effectivity for all creators, we have fixed this problem caused by odd behaviour of AWS. Details

📚 Updated dependencies - We have updated the add-on dependencies to deliver you the latest, safest and the most effective code in the libraries the add-on depends on. Details

For those who love diving into the details, the full changelog offers a deep dive. 📖

gh-blenderkit-blendkit.title: BlendKit v3.8.1.230808 — BlenderKit
gh-blenderkit-blendkit.summary: Greetings BlenderKit enthusiasts! We're thrilled to present to you BlenderKit version 3.8.1.230808, infused with advanced features and resolved issues. Our team has been working tirelessly to refine your 3D asset management experience, making it sleeker,…
gh-blenderkit-blendkit.html:
Greetings BlenderKit enthusiasts! We're thrilled to present to you BlenderKit version 3.8.1.230808, infused with advanced features and resolved issues. Our team has been working tirelessly to refine your 3D asset management experience, making it sleeker, faster, and more delightful.

Improvements:

🎨 Enhanced Asset Version Indicators: Your assets are feeling more expressive than ever! Now, assets sourced from higher Blender versions won't just sit there; they'll tell you their exact version details right below their expanded preview. Anticipate distinct messages fine-tuned to the asset's version difference, whether it's major, minor, or a patch. #744

⚠️ SSL Checks Option: We've added a sprinkle of flexibility to your BlenderKit preferences, enabling you to disable SSL checks at will. Proceed with caution, though; while power can be thrilling, it also calls for responsibility. #742

📚 Bookmarks Unleashed: Say goodbye to keeping your bookmarks under the wraps of experimental features. From now on, you can access and manage your bookmarks anytime you wish, without venturing into experimental territory. #754

Fixes:

🔐 Enhanced Token Privacy in Logs: Privacy is our priority. Temporary tokens in logs are now wearing a mask of three asterisks, and permanent tokens don a mask of five. The curtain of privacy also extends to the logs in the add-on and the daemon. #719

🚀 Background Blenders Startup: We're all about stability! From now, we're launching background Blender instances with the --factory-startup flag to ensure seamless rendering and unpacking. Say hello to a Blender in the background unaffected by individual user configurations or add-ons. #746

🖌️ Brush Loading in Sculpt Mode: Our sculpt mode switch has been given a tune-up. It now not only switches to sculpt mode correctly but at the same it also directly loads the brush for your creative endeavors. #761

🧹 Explicit Logger Levels: To keep things neat and tidy, we've added explicit logging levels to bk_logger. This change keeps the log cleaner for developers of other add-ons if they set logging.level to debug or lower. #750

👤 User-Specific Temp Directories: Unique just like you! Every user now gets their very own temp directory, putting an end to the communal '/tmp' directory in UNIX systems. Your username will be part of your directory's name, adding that personal touch. #749

🔍 Enhanced Check for Brush's Thumbnail: We've fixed the faulty checks for non-existing brush props. We now peek into utils.get_active_brush().icon_filepath and let you know if your brush icon is MIA with a friendly error message. #764

🛡️ StructRNA & Memory Cleanup: Solved an issue of the BlenderKitDisclaimerOperator StructRNA removal upon unregistration, and fixed memory leaks on Blender exit with BlenderKit active. A cleaner, more efficient Blender experience awaits! #770

A heartfelt thank you to our remarkable user community - your unwavering support is our motivation! We eagerly await your feedback on these latest upgrades. For a comprehensive overview, check our complete change log. Stay inspired, and revel in your blending endeavors! 🎉

gh-blenderkit-blendkit.title: BlendKit v3.8.0.230711 — BlenderKit
gh-blenderkit-blendkit.summary: We are delighted to present the new release of BlenderKit 3.8.0.230711-rc. This update contains several enhancements and bug fixes, which aim to provide better user experience and improved functionality. Here's a summary of what's new and improved:…
gh-blenderkit-blendkit.html:
We are delighted to present the new release of BlenderKit 3.8.0.230711-rc. This update contains several enhancements and bug fixes, which aim to provide better user experience and improved functionality. Here's a summary of what's new and improved:

Improvements

🔒 Private Uploads Do Not Require Category Filled In (#661): Private uploads now require only the asset, name, and thumbnail, making the process more faster and user-friendly. See the full changes here.

📁 Category Icon Addition and Search Parameter Updates: Category browsing now displays results for the asset type without automatically clearing it when switching to different asset type and then back. The update also allows parameters to be shared between categories, and scrolls to zero for new search results. See the full changes here.

⚙️ Add Property for Search Field Width, Cleaner Preferences Menu (#702): We've revamped the preferences menu and added an option to set the search field width. In addition, we now provide a greyed list of important paths at the end of preferences for users to understand which directories to delete for add-on cleaning. See the full changes here.

🔍 Uppercase Enabled in Search: We have enabled the use of uppercase characters in the search functionality. This adjustment aims to enhance the search experience and facilitate manual entry of some parameters. See the full changes here.

Fixes

🔧 Fix uploads of HDRs (#724): We've addressed an issue where the BlenderKitHDRUploadProps object was unable to locate the 'thumbnail' attribute. See the full changes here.

⏱️ Improved Handling of Timed Out API Key Tokens (#733): This update introduces measures to handle expired API key tokens better. When a token times out, the add-on will attempt a refresh. In case of a refresh failure, it automatically logs the user out and displays a helpful message. More details can be found here.

🐛 Fix Context in Blender 4.0 and Also blf: This release resolves the issue of search results appearing black in Blender 4.0.0, and fixes the change of context parameters and context override. See the full changes here.

🔧 Fix Error on Assetbar Show, Error on Report Draw in Blender 4.0.0-alpha (#687): The latest update removes the DPI from def get_text_size, without changing the results. The 2D_ / 3D_ prefixes for built-in shader names have been deprecated. See the full changes here.

For more details on these and other changes in this release, please refer to the Full Changelog. Thank you for your continuous support and feedback that help us make BlenderKit better.

gh-blenderkit-blendkit.title: BlendKit v3.7.0.230601 — BlenderKit
gh-blenderkit-blendkit.summary: We're thrilled to announce BlenderKit v3.7.0.230601, marking another milestone not only in feature enhancements but also in community growth, as we celebrate surpassing 500k users! This update delivers improved error handling, a refined upload UI, essential…
gh-blenderkit-blendkit.html:
We're thrilled to announce BlenderKit v3.7.0.230601, marking another milestone not only in feature enhancements but also in community growth, as we celebrate surpassing 500k users! This update delivers improved error handling, a refined upload UI, essential bug fixes, and more, contributing to an enriched 3D art creation experience in Blender. Join our expanding community and elevate your artistic journey with BlenderKit today!

What's new

🔄 Better Upload Handling: Not all textures packed correctly? No problem! Our updated upload process handles it like a champ!​ #660

👌 UI Fixes: We've ironed out a few wrinkles in our UI, fixing an issue with the complexity display and sprucing up the upload interface for a smoother experi​ence. #663

🖼️ Thumbnail Rendering Completion Fix: We noticed that the GUI might not always indicate when automatic thumbnail renders had successfully completed. That's been corrected - now, every render's finish line is clearly visible in the GUI, ensuring you're always up-to-date with your thumbnail's status. #679

📦 Empty Shader Node Group Handling: We've enhanced the upload process to gracefully handle cases where the ShaderNodeGroup.node_tree is None, indicating an empty group. This update will prevent unexpected errors during upload, ensuring a smoother, more flexible process. #681

🚨 Thumbnail Download Failure Indication: A new feature sets a distinct icon when a thumbnail download task encounters an error, providing clear visibility of any issues. #645

🛠️ Enhanced Error Handling: No more scratching your head over server issues! Our system now raises a red flag for server response codes higher than 399, catching issues right away and letting you what was wrong. #602

🔎 More Detailed Error Reporting: Say hello to our beefed-up error handling process, delivering detailed error messages which will help with debugging and solving problems. #646

🚦 Failed Rating Visibility: Ever uploaded a rating and wondered if it went through? Wonder no more! Failed rating uploads are now shown more clearly, so you're always in the loop. #672

🎛️ Complexity Display Fix: We've addressed a rare but pesky bug that sometimes hid complexity from the wh enum UI. Now, complexity will always stand in the spotlight where it belongs! #657

⚙️ Updated Dependencies: We've brought all our dependencies up-to-date, providing you with the latest and greatest secure codebase. #653

gh-blenderkit-blendkit.html:
We are excited to announce the release of BlenderKit add-on v3.6.0.230417, which comes with numerous improvements and new features that enhance your experience with BlenderKit. Below are the highlights of this release.

Improvements

Upload and Download Functionality Improvement

In this release, we have fixed the failing appends after download and improved the download functionality in #558 and #566. Additionally, we have increased the timeout for uploads and downloads in #581.

UI Tweaks and Performance Improvements

We have made a number of UI tweaks and performance improvements in this release, including:

  • Improving the asset bar performance in #567 and #576
  • Fixing errors with empty search results in #545
  • Providing an option to disable online announcements in #590
  • Implementing a solution to switch SSL Context between default and preconfigured contexts in #589, the latter of which might help in cases when SSL errors are faced by the users.
  • Don't show search, upload panels, and header bar when offline in #544.
  • Minor asset bar fixes post-merge in #157.
  • Made the DNS check asynchronous in #577.
  • WebP - don't write error to .webp file in #578.
  • Increased timeout for uploads and downloads in #586.
  • Show info when global dir is not accessible in #585.
  • Fixed rating complexity UI in #611.

Experimental feature: Bookmarks

BlenderKit Add-on v3.6.0.230417 introduces a new Bookmarks feature that allows logged-in users to save their favorite assets for easy access later. This feature has been implemented in #543 and #549. To activate this feature enable experimental features in the add-on preferences.

Bug Fixes

BlenderKit Add-on v3.6.0.230417 also comes with numerous bug fixes, including:

  • Add-on to daemon connection now ignores system proxy in #540.
  • Fixed errors with empty search results in #545.
  • Search, upload panels, and header bar are now hidden when offline in #588.
  • Improved online check in daemon and made it real-time in #546.
  • Fixed spamming tips in #553.
  • Updated description and tags on download from search result data in #555.
  • Fixed failing appends after download in #558.
  • Disclaimer task now returns an empty dictionary instead of None as results in #561.
  • Fixed version number in #562
  • Fixed asset bar redraw in #597.
  • Missing assetBaseId and Id on re-upload is now fixed in #196.
  • Use API token when retrieving the disclaimer in #603.
  • Print stdout and stderr when unpacking fails in #610.
  • Improved feedback on dependencies installation failure in #619.
  • Mentioned in preferences that HTTPS proxies are not supported in #461.
  • Put sys.stdout.reconfigure() into try-except in #617.

For a more detailed list of changes, please see the full changelog.

We hope that you enjoy using BlenderKit add-on v3.6.0.230417 and welcome your feedback on this release!

We are happy to announce the release of BlenderKit v3.3.1.221122. As much as we love to bring you the great new features we also know that the devil is in the details. And so this release mostly focuses on minor improvements and fixes.

  • Improved tests: nightly build URLs are now loaded dynamically - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/364
  • Handle API limit exceeded error - due to DDOS attacks the server limits max number of requests in time window, this should not affect real users - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/374

  • Resolutions upload fails sometime - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/347

On the occasion of the Blender Conference 2022, the BlenderKit development team is pleased to announce the release of BlenderKit 3.3.0.221027.

New features

  • Brushes cannot be downloaded if not at sculpt or paint modes to prevent download errors - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/317
  • Ratings are now disabled for locked assets (users cannot rate assets which they cannot download and try) - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/329
  • Added option to choose IP version, choosing IPv4 only instead of default BOTH option might help with SSL errors for some users - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/278
  • Removed long daemon startup message from GUI as requested by several users - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/321
  • Added support for PCKE OAuth to improve security of logins - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/302
  • Exceptions in the daemon's ensure_future() are handled in a better way, improved error feedback to users - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/326
  • Correct filename and line are now logged in add_report() and log.py, improving ability to debug user reports - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/337
  • Added tests for search and reports, improving stability of the add-on - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/292
  • Improved headers in daemon, added headers to all requests - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/308

Bug fixes

  • Categories are fetched on scene load, leading to correct numbers shown for assets in categories - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/330
  • Made sslcontext.load_default_certs optional so if they miss on OS it does not lead to an error - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/305
  • Fixed status updates when reuploading metadata/thumbnails - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/334
  • Updated tests - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/pull/332

gh-blenderkit-blendkit.summary: BlenderKit team is pleased to announce release of BlenderKit 3.1.5. UPDATE WARNING FOR WINDOWS SYSTEMS Only applies for auto-updates from version lower than 3.1.4. For updates on Windows please be aware of broken auto-updater in 3.1.1 and 3.1.3 which will lead…
gh-blenderkit-blendkit.html:
BlenderKit team is pleased to announce release of BlenderKit 3.1.5.

UPDATE WARNING FOR WINDOWS SYSTEMS

Only applies for auto-updates from version lower than 3.1.4. For updates on Windows please be aware of broken auto-updater in 3.1.1 and 3.1.3 which will lead to failing automatic installation of 3.1.5 (more information at: https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/issues/131). In order to install 3.1.5 we strongly advice to remove 3.1.1 or 3.1.3 and install 3.1.5 manually from .zip file. This way you will skip the auto-updater bug and will have clean and working installation of 3.1.5.

As the bug was fixed in 3.1.4, auto-updates from 3.1.4 to 3.1.5 or higher are working as expected. We are deeply sorry for inconvenience caused by 3rd party library for automatic updates.

Improvements:

  • Error on asset import - improve error message if addon does not have rights to folder (#21)
  • Wrong enumeration causes spam in console log: WARN (bpy.rna): source/blender/python/intern/bpy_rna.c:1346 pyrna_enum_to_py: current value '512' matches no enum in 'SCENE_OT_blenderkit_download', '(null)', 'resolution' (#157)
  • Writing to ID classes in this context is not allowed: thumbnail_notready.jpg, Image datablock, error setting Image.name #159

Bug fixes:

  • BlenderKit logs out occasionally and after crashes (#123)
  • Placing some assets into scene might lead to removal of already placed assets (#44)
  • Download of asset can lead to crash (#76)

Known issues:

  • FROM 3.1.3 TO 3.1.5: Broken auto-updater on Windows - auto-update from 3.1.3 to 3.1.5 will cause problems on Windows, this could not be fixed retrospectively for already downloaded 3.1.3. Updates got fixed in 3.1.4 so updates from 3.1.4 to future releases will be fine. Please update to 3.1.5 on Windows manually by removing the add-on and installing from .zip file - https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/issues/131

Full Changelog: https://github.com/BlenderKit/blenderkit/compare/v3.1.4...v3.1.5

    • Root Relative: Source animation root bone is transformed relative to the starting frame on destination animation, so that the root bone follows on from the exiting animation.

    • ARKit Proxy:
      • The ARKit proxy can be used as a target for LiveLink face transfer (e.g. from Face-it add-on)

      • Adjustment parameters can be used to alter expression strength, relax / exaggerate expressions, shift the directional bias towards Left/Right and Up/Down expressions.

gh-aafkegros-microscopynodes.summary: Microscopy Nodes 3.1.0 Version 3.1.0 substantially expands how microscopy data can be manipulated through Geometry Nodes. It introduces more complete masking, annotation, and projection workflows while improving loading, physical scaling, animation, and…
gh-aafkegros-microscopynodes.html:
Microscopy Nodes 3.1.0

Version 3.1.0 substantially expands how microscopy data can be manipulated through Geometry Nodes. It introduces more complete masking, annotation, and projection workflows while improving loading, physical scaling, animation, and Blender 5.2 integration.

Expanded Geometry Nodes workflows

The Geometry Nodes menus now include:

  • Annotation groups
  • Grid addition and joining
  • Subvolume creation
  • Grid manipulation
  • Grid-to-mesh projection
  • Color LUTs
  • General-purpose masking tools

Slicing has been incorporated into a more flexible masking workflow using grid mathematics. The default slice cube can optionally use this new grid-mask mode.

Blender 5.2 bundles are now used to propagate holder variables and join grids. World scale is passed through parent objects and automatically handed over to newly created Geometry Nodes setups where applicable.

Physical scaling and scene management

The previous pixel-to-centimeter conversion has been removed. All scaling is now physically based.

A new automatic scale finder chooses an appropriate scene scale when data is loaded and whenever scaling is retriggered. Scene objects can switch live based on the current scene scale, and the available scale options now provide finer coverage across every order of magnitude.

The Scene model has also been expanded, laying the groundwork for broader scene-level functionality in future releases.

Loading and animation
  • Loading can now be cancelled.
  • Local files are created using subprocess.
  • Masked regions can be reloaded independently as sparse VDBs.
  • Frame animation is exposed as a Geometry Nodes socket, making it easier to find and animate.
  • The load panel has been redesigned to better organize load-time options.
Architecture and compatibility
  • file_to_array implementations have been reworked to follow the Microscopy Nodes 3.x architecture.
  • The data model no longer stores loaded data directly and is now fully serializable.
  • Imports have been simplified and cleaned up.
  • Several broken behaviors and incompatibilities with current Blender policies have been fixed.
  • Microscopy Nodes now targets Blender 5.2.
Colors and organization
  • Color handling and existing LUTs have been refined.
  • Black to color has been added to the color LUTs.
  • Each Microscopy Nodes object now receives a colored frame for easier identification in the node editor.

Compatibility notes

  • Microscopy Nodes 3.1.0 requires Blender 5.2.
  • Pixel-to-centimeter scaling has been removed in favor of physical scaling.
  • Integrations relying on the old file_to_array behavior or in-memory data model may need to be updated.

gh-aafkegros-microscopynodes.summary: Release Overview This release reworks a large part of the internal structure and formalizes the data model.Most changes are preparatory for v3.1, with a few added features, some interaction changes, and several 5.x bug fixes. Documentation has been updated on…
gh-aafkegros-microscopynodes.html:
Release Overview

This release reworks a large part of the internal structure and formalizes the data model.
Most changes are preparatory for v3.1, with a few added features, some interaction changes, and several 5.x bug fixes.

Documentation has been updated on the website (previous versions can still be selected).

Core Changes

  • Formalizes the internal data model
  • Unifies materials and thus changes core GN trees
  • Removes the cache; all data is now loaded directly from within the GN tree
  • Adds internal support for affine transforms (proper input methods still to come #169)
  • Introduces a shared time axis as an animation object (#124)
  • Moves volumes to a grid-based workflow
  • Simplifies the axis object
  • Prepares groundwork for API building

Shading Changes

  • Implements shared shaders for all objects, with channels stacked in the same window
  • Updates volume shader:
    • Adds emission / scatter switch
    • Improves alpha slider readability
  • Fixes volume clipping issues in Cycles (#175)

File I/O

  • Deprecates .abc writing in favor of .obj
    • .obj still has limitations (notably OID reading)
    • Writing can now be done without Blender operators

Fixes

  • Fixes #133
  • Fixes #139

Notes

This release is primarily structural and intended to support upcoming features in v3.1.

gh-samffprice-loopcut.html:
The first build of Loopcut: an AI agent that works inside Blender. Built on Blender 5.2.2 LTS.

Download

Platform File
macOS, Apple silicon loopcut-v0.1.0-arm64.dmg
Windows, 64-bit, portable loopcut-v0.1.0-windows64.zip: unzip anywhere and run blender-launcher.exe
Windows, 64-bit, installer loopcut-v0.1.0-windows64.msi

Installing on a Mac

Open the .dmg and drag Loopcut to Applications. This build is not yet signed with an Apple Developer ID, so macOS will say the app is damaged the first time. Run this once in Terminal, then open it normally:

xattr -cr /Applications/Loopcut.app

Installing on Windows

The build is not yet code-signed, so SmartScreen will warn the first time: choose "More info", then "Run anyway". Cycles renders on NVIDIA (CUDA, OptiX) and AMD (HIP) cards with the .zip. The .msi of this release was packaged without the GPU kernels, so Cycles renders on the CPU there; EEVEE and everything else are unaffected. The next release fixes the installer.

What is in it

  • The Loopcut panel, docked beside the 3D viewport (Cmd+L jumps to it): chat, it writes and runs bpy, looks at the viewport to check its work, and every turn has a checkpoint you can restore.
  • First run: bring your Blender preferences, add-ons, keymap and themes along in one click, then connect a model (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including a local one).
  • Attach reference images by dropping them on the panel.
  • Everything Blender 5.2.2 does, including Cycles on Metal. Loopcut keeps its settings in its own folder and never writes to Blender's.

Loopcut is free software under the GNU GPL v3 or later, like Blender; the source for this build is the v0.1.0 tag of this repository. Loopcut is based on Blender and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Blender Foundation.

luxcore.html:
This is the release of BlendLuxCore version 2.11.1

This version is compatible with Blender versions 4.5 LTS and 5.2 LTS. Non-LTS versions in this range usually work, but are not explicitly supported.

This bugfix release fixes the following issues compared to BlendLuxCore 2.11.0:

  • Point to LuxCore v2.11.2
  • Fix an error that indefinitely blocks viewport-GPU rendering
  • Improve dynamic library loading on Linux, fixes tbb-related crashes on Linux with Blender 4.5 LTS
  • Fix initial assignment of the world cache. Reduces unnecessary viewport restart
  • Fix an issue with LuxcoreOnlineLibrary preview images in Blender 5.0+

For a detailed list, including various bugfixes and backend changes, see our wiki: https://wiki.luxcorerender.org/LuxCoreRender_Release_Notes_v2.11

This release was built from the following point in LuxCoreRender/BlendLuxCore:

  • Branch: refs/heads/main
  • Commit: 5e204a72e0a2a9b71c04eb7175be0d10ed29b79e

luxcore.summary: This is the release of BlendLuxCore version 2.11.0 This version is compatible with Blender versions 4.5 LTS and 5.2 LTS. Non-LTS versions in this range usually work, but are not explicitly supported. [!WARNING] There is currently a known issue - affecting…
luxcore.html:
This is the release of BlendLuxCore version 2.11.0

This version is compatible with Blender versions 4.5 LTS and 5.2 LTS. Non-LTS versions in this range usually work, but are not explicitly supported.

[!WARNING] There is currently a known issue - affecting Blender 4.5 on Linux - of dependency conflicts, which causes Blender to crash. This may require larger works to fix, but we did not want to delay release of this version as most platform appeared unaffected during testing.

The most important changes since v2.10.2 are:

  • Compatibility for Blender 5.2
  • New shape node: merge on distance
  • Subdivision: new (simple) crease management
  • Subdivision: new adaptive setting for refinement
  • Fresnel texture accepts n,k values greater than 1
  • Removed some old limitations for using Intel GPU devices
  • When using shadow color, the use of additional light-tracing rays (for artistic purposes) can be enabled or disabled per material
  • 2D-mapping now allows rotation around the center of UV-space instead of only the corner
  • Unification of the default behavior when using shadow-color: Path+Light engine now matches the BiDir engine behavior.

[!IMPORTANT] The unification of default behavior will break the look of existing scenes that use path+light engine!

For a detailed list, including various bugfixes and backend changes, see our wiki: https://wiki.luxcorerender.org/LuxCoreRender_Release_Notes_v2.11

This release was built from the following point in LuxCoreRender/BlendLuxCore:

  • Branch: refs/heads/main
  • Commit: 094e238a2730461d83d3cc8f6e5c84935a6be44e

Blender 2.80

This release includes builds for Blender 2.80. They can be found in the asset list at the bottom, containing "blender2.80" in their names. These builds are not as stable and bug-free as the ones for Blender 2.79, but on the other hand they contain more features than the 2.79 builds.

Note that in Blender 2.80, you can not use the auto-updater in the addon preferences to update from v2.2beta3 to v2.2beta4 or later. From v2.2beta4 on it should work.

Known Issues

Known issues that will be fixed in the future:

  • When using Cycles nodes, nested node groups are not supported
  • Cycles light settings are not being used
  • Unit scale is currently handled like in Cycles (i.e. ignored)
  • When adding nodes to a Cycles node tree while LuxCore is selected as render engine, most nodes in the "shader" category are not available. You'll have to switch to Cycles, add the nodes and then switch back.

Reporting Bugs

If you find any bugs, problems, weird UI arrangements, missing tooltips etc. that are not on the list above, please open an issue in our bugtracker: https://github.com/LuxCoreRender/BlendLuxCore/issues/new

Info

  • Here's a video showing how to render a Cycles scene with LuxCore: https://youtu.be/kglbpZl6Sck
  • General info about the 2.80 port: https://github.com/LuxCoreRender/BlendLuxCore/issues/166
  • Info about the state of the Cycles scene reader: https://github.com/LuxCoreRender/BlendLuxCore/issues/272 (Not strictly part of the 2.80 port, but started in the course of it)

molecular-nodes.summary: Major Breaking Changes This is a HUGE update, which includes a pretty major overhaul for a lot of the internals, the API and the nodes. This bumps the minimum bpy>=5.2.0 to take advantage of the new node features that have been introduced through the 5.*…
molecular-nodes.html:
Major Breaking Changes

This is a HUGE update, which includes a pretty major overhaul for a lot of the internals, the API and the nodes. This bumps the minimum bpy>=5.2.0 to take advantage of the new node features that have been introduced through the 5.* series so far.

The biggest change that most users will come across is the 10x larger world scale. This brings 1 nm == 1 m inside of Blender whereas previous 1 nm == 0.1 m. It was slightly "more convenient" but lead to a lot of issues with scaling and problems in simulation.

Some nodes / features are currently left out for some final improvements (simulations, DNA) but I'm getting this released for some initial user testing in the lead-up to a MN workshop in London in two weeks.

molecular-nodes.html:
Overhauled internal and external APIs for importing structures and handling styles. Support for annotations through GPU overlays added among many other improvements by @PardhavMaradani for GSoC 2025.

Scripting and rendering via the API is now much more possible a large amount of examples added to the documentation. There are still many rough edges and design decisions to be worked out but headless rendering is now much more of a reality.

molecular-nodes.title: Molecular Nodes v4.2.4 — for Blender 4.2
molecular-nodes.summary: Extensions Platform Changed architecture of add-on to be compatible with new extensions platform in Blender 4.2 (here). Bundles the add-on with the required python packages, so installation is as simple as clicking 'install' from inside of Blender's extension…
molecular-nodes.html:
Extensions Platform

Changed architecture of add-on to be compatible with new extensions platform in Blender 4.2 (here). Bundles the add-on with the required python packages, so installation is as simple as clicking 'install' from inside of Blender's extension system. No need to manually download or install anything additional. Updates for the add-on can also be delivered and installed this way.

Nodes

Color Tag

Utilising the new color_tag attribute for custom node groups, all provided node groups are now colored appropriately.

Selection Nodes

Selection nodes have been split into individual node groups and given And and Or inputs to more easily construct selection chains with common boolean operations.

Topology Nodes

Topology nodes have been partially overhauled, with some nodes moved to utility nodes and extras included such as the DSSP and Phi / Psi nodes. Phi / Psi nodes do not require pre-computation of any values and can be used just like any other field.

Color Nodes

Res Name and Element nodes now go higher, utilising the Index Switch node underneath and panels to ensure the UI remains usable.

Trajectories

The underlying method for importing and managing MDAnalysis trajectory / Universes has been overhauled. They are now imported as a Trajectory object. Trajectories along with all other molecular data that is imported is now kept around inside of a MNSession, which is stored under bpy.context.scene.MNSession. This session is pickled and save next to the .blend file on save, so that all of the data can persist between Blender sessions on load.

Selections

Because the connection to the universe is maintained, we now have live and updateable selections.

Calculations

Initial support for functions can be added to the Trajectories. These functions will be executed with the universe as an input, and the output is stored on the resulting mesh. This gives access to custom calculations to be executed in python and the results to be used inside of Geometry Nodes.

Radeon ProRender 3.6.0 for Blender, enhances both viewport and final rendering modes:

  • RPR Final uses HIP instead of OpenCL.
  • RPR Interactive (using Vulkan and hardware ray tracing) now includes RESTIR-based lighting calculations and FSR upsampling for faster interactive viewport rendering.

prorender.summary: Support for Blender 3.3 and Blender 3.4 has been added, including support for the new hair system. The RPR Interactive mode has been improved with the following developments: Better support for more shader node types; Even faster rendering with optimized…
prorender.html:
• Support for Blender 3.3 and Blender 3.4 has been added, including support for the new hair system.
  • The RPR Interactive mode has been improved with the following developments:
    • Better support for more shader node types;
    • Even faster rendering with optimized settings out of the box;
    • Hair rendering support;
    • More AOVs supported;
    • Support for OpenColorIO texture spaces;
    • Shadow Catcher support;
    • Per face materials are supported;
    • IES lights are now supported.
  • A new Bevel Shader node has been added. This can be used to create small rounded edges on objects. In the physical world, objects rarely have completely sharp edges like polygons. Using this node will enhance the details of artists’ renders.
  • Support for the Double Sided node has been added, which allows attaching a different shader to each side of an object mesh.
  • The “Pixel Filter” (anti-aliasing) setting for the RPR Final mode has been re-enabled.

prorender.title: Radeon ProRender v3.2.2 — for Blender 3.2
prorender.summary: Radeon ProRender for Blender 3.2.2 This release is adds the following features: Subsurface Scattering and Volume shaders now work in RPR 2.0. This allows the rendering of organic materials, such as skin, which absorb light into their interior. Volume shaders…
prorender.html:
Radeon ProRender for Blender 3.2.2

This release is adds the following features:

  • Subsurface Scattering and Volume shaders now work in RPR 2.0. This allows the rendering of organic materials, such as skin, which absorb light into their interior. Volume shaders can now also be used for simple fog boxes. Also the Volume Scatter node is supported.
  • Viewport denoising and upscaling improves the interactivity and speed of Viewport rendering. With the use of the Radeon Image Filter Library, this allows Radeon ProRender to render at half resolution faster, and then upscale to the full size of the Viewport. Deformation motion blur gives accurate motion blur to objects which are being deformed, for example, a flag flapping in the wind or a ball squashing. Besides, motion blur export has been optimized, and a setting for disabling deformation motion blur has been added.
  • A new RPR Toon Shader has been added. This enables cartoon-style shading for a non-photorealistic look. Toon shaders can be used in a “simple” mode for just setting a color or a gradient of different colors for shadow vs lit areas of the object. Support for Blender 2.93 has been added.
  • The look of “blocky” displacements has been significantly improved by enabling subdivision by default on objects with displacement shaders. However, this does render slower, and can be overridden with the RPR Object Subdivision settings.
  • Support has been added for Reflection Catcher and Transparent background in the Viewport in the Full mode.
  • Support for the Voronoi Texture node is added.

For more information on changes and fixes see the Release Notes

Supports Blender versions 2.8X and 2.90, 2.91, 2.92, and 2.93

prorender.title: Radeon ProRender v3.1.0 — for Blender
prorender.summary: This release is adds the following features: Support for AMD Radeon™ RX 6700 XT graphics cards has been added. Cryptomatte AOVs make it easy to filter objects by name or material when using compositors that support Cryptomatte (including the Blender…
prorender.html:
This release is adds the following features:

  • Support for AMD Radeon™ RX 6700 XT graphics cards has been added.
  • Cryptomatte AOVs make it easy to filter objects by name or material when using compositors that support Cryptomatte (including the Blender Cryptomatte compositor node)
  • A 16-bit Machine Learning Denoiser option is now available to provide for less memory usage and greater speed.
  • The speed and responsiveness of the viewport render has been vastly improved under RPR 2.0:
  • An option for using Machine Learning Denoising and Upscaling the viewport render is enabled under the Viewport Settings. We now render faster at ½ resolution and use the Machine Learning Upscaler to enhance the resolution;
  • Changing the properties tabs no longer restarts the viewport render;
  • Stopping the viewport render is now much faster;
  • Various other fixes to speed up the viewport render have been added.
  • An often requested feature, Box mapping in the Image Texture node, is now supported!
  • Support for Principled Hair BSDF has been added.
  • UV Lookup nodes and math nodes now work in the High, Medium, Low modes.

For more information on changes and fixes see the Release Notes

Supports Blender versions 2.8X and 2.90, 2.91, 2.92. Does not support the unreleased Blender 2.93 yet due to a python version incompatibility

prorender.html:
This release is an update to version 3.0 with a few changes:

  • Various changes to better match Cycles scenes in general “look” of the renders (please note, artists should still expect to have to adjust settings when moving from Cycles to ProRender).
    • Object Ray Visibility uses Cycles ones. That is, the Cycles object visibility is automatically used rather than separate ProRender visibility settings.
    • Point, Sun and Spot light default intensities are closer to Cycles.
    • Sun Light softness matches Cycles.
    • The Velvet and Hair Shaders match Cycles better.
    • Clamp Radiance is no longer enabled by default. For users experiencing fireflies, enable this setting in the Render Settings.
  • Fixes for contour rendering.
  • Improved interactivity with Viewport Renders.
  • Some issues with texture compression present in version 3.0.1 are fixed.
  • Issues with normal maps (related to texture compression) are also fixed.

For more information on changes see the Release Notes

Supports Blender versions 2.8X and 2.9X

prorender.html:
The new plug-in version incorporates version 2.0 of our Radeon™ ProRender system and brings about significant changes and enhancements:

  • Hardware-accelerated ray tracing on AMD Radeon™ RX 6000 series GPUs.
  • Better scaling across multiple devices: the use of two or more GPUs gives a better performance improvement with Radeon ProRender-2.0 than with Radeon ProRender 1.0 in most cases.
  • Less noise for a given number of render samples. Using the same number of samples as with Radeon ProRender 1.0 may be slower in some scenes, but noise will be significantly lower.
  • RPR 2.0 is the default render mode called “Full”. Users who wish to use RPR 1.0 can set the render quality mode to “Legacy”.

For more information on changes see the Release Notes

sketchfab.title: Sketchfab Plugin 1.8.0 — Sketchfab For Blender
sketchfab.summary: Fixes Blender 4.x uploads now work — Sketchfab's backend can't process .blend files saved by Blender 4.x (#118, #130), so 4.x+ exports now go out as GLB via Blender's own glTF exporter instead. Hidden layers no longer forced into the upload, and no longer…
sketchfab.html:
Fixes

  • Blender 4.x uploads now work — Sketchfab's backend can't process .blend files saved by Blender 4.x (#118, #130), so 4.x+ exports now go out as GLB via Blender's own glTF exporter instead.
  • Hidden layers no longer forced into the upload, and no longer break dependent geometry — hidden/unselected mesh objects used to be deleted from the export outright even when another exported object still depended on them (e.g. a hidden Boolean cutter), forcing a bake-then-delete workaround. Dependency-linked hidden objects are now kept; unrelated hidden objects are excluded, including on full-scene (non "Selection Only") exports, which previously uploaded every layer regardless of visibility.
  • Objects needing both baked modifiers and shape keys are now exported correctly by splitting them into a separate pass and merging the result, rather than losing one or the other.

Installation

Download sketchfab-plugin-1-8-0.zip below, then in Blender: Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > Install..., select the zip, and enable "Sketchfab Plugin".

Full Changelog: https://github.com/sketchfab/blender-plugin/compare/1.7.3...1.8.0

sketchfab.summary: Patch release. Bug fixes and internal cleanup around API token login — no new features. Fixes The "Report an issue" button now opens the GitHub issue tracker instead of the Sketchfab Help Center's exporter request form. (#190) Your API token is restored into…
sketchfab.html:
Patch release. Bug fixes and internal cleanup around API token login — no new features.

Fixes

  • The "Report an issue" button now opens the GitHub issue tracker instead of the Sketchfab Help Center's exporter request form. (#190)
  • Your API token is restored into the panel field after restarting Blender. Previously the cached token was loaded and you were logged in, but the token box rendered empty. (#190)
  • A rejected API token is removed from the cache. A token that has since been revoked was restored and re-failed on every start, with no remedy but an explicit Log Out. It is now dropped when Sketchfab answers 401. A server error or rate limit no longer reports "Invalid API token", and no longer discards a valid token. (#190)
  • Stale credentials from older versions are cleared on logout. Versions up to 1.6.1 cached an OAuth access_token and the account email; both are now purged. (#190)

Internal

Email/password login was removed in 1.7.0, leaving unreachable OAuth code behind. That is now gone — the OAuth client id and endpoint, the unused access_token handling and its Bearer header branch, and the orphaned urllib import. The API token is stored in one place instead of two kept in sync by hand, which is what caused the restore bug above.

Installation

Download sketchfab-plugin-1-7-3.zip below and install via Edit → Preferences → Add-ons → Install….

Full changelog: https://github.com/sketchfab/blender-plugin/compare/1.7.2...1.7.3

sketchfab.html:
Bug-fix release focused on import reliability and add-on stability.

Fixes

  • Add-on no longer fails to enable when the cache directory can't be created. updateCacheDirectory() now falls back to the system temp directory and never aborts registration on permission/invalid-path errors (missing drive, denied permissions, unusual characters). Fixes #157, #132, #87, #126, #129, #77.
  • Sketchfab panels now appear in all viewport modes, not only Object Mode — so the tab shows when you open a file saved in Edit/Sculpt mode. (Import remains gated to Object Mode, with a clear message.) Fixes #149.
  • clear_search no longer assumes the window manager is named "WinMan", fixing a KeyError in headless/background sessions. Fixes #109.
  • Export "Selection only" no longer crashes on objects in collections excluded from the view layer. Fixes #22.

Installation

Download sketchfab-plugin-1-7-1.zip below and install via Edit → Preferences → Add-ons → Install….

sketchfab.html:
Compatibility and feature update for the Sketchfab Blender add-on.

Highlights

  • Blender 4.x compatibility — the importer now detects the available render engine at runtime, using EEVEE Next on Blender 4.x and falling back to EEVEE on Blender 2.8x–4.1, fixing model import failures on Blender 4.2+ (#178). The current engine is also left untouched when set to Workbench.
  • Automatic attribution — downloading a model now generates an sf_attributions text block crediting the author, license, and source URL (#134).
  • Simplified login — authentication is now API-token only; the deprecated email/password flow has been removed (#184).

Installation

Download sketchfab-plugin-1-7-0.zip below and install it via Edit → Preferences → Add-ons → Install… in Blender.

Full changelog: https://github.com/sketchfab/blender-plugin/compare/1.6.1...1.7.0

sketchfab.html:
Sketchfab Plugin v1.1.0 for Blender

Import glTF assets into Blender using Sketchfab download API

The plugin is available for both Blender 2.79 and 2.8

Changelog
  • Browse your own models (available for PRO users only)

Documentation

If you have any issue, please have a look at this section before using "Report an issue" button in the plugin. You can also report through this link.

⚠️ If you are using Blender on OSX/Linux ⚠️

The plugin doesn't use the default embeded ssl lib but uses it's own version (embedded with the plugin).

If you have any issue or any side effect caused by these overriding packages, please report us.

How to use

Installation

Download one of the following .zip files according to the version of Blender you are using and install it as a regular blender addon:

  • Download for Blender 2.79
  • Download for Blender 2.80
Login, browse and import models

The addon is available in View3D -> Tools under the tab 'Sketchfab'.

You don't need to login to browse models but it's required if you want to import a model.

PRO users can now access their own models

If you are a PRO user, you can also use the My Models filter to search and have a private access to your personal library of models, which includes all your published models (including the private ones)

Selecting an model in the results will the model info accordingly

Importing models into Blender:

The plugin allows to download and import 100k+ free downloadable models into Blender. Materials are converted to CYCLE materials for Blender 2.79, and to EEVEE materials for Blender 2.80.

Known limits/issues and further improvements

My model doesn't look good, it's different from Sketchfab

There are still improvements to do on import, and Sketchfab to Blender (through glTF) conversion has some limits. This section will give some hints about differences or issues that can be encountered when importing models into Blender.

I don't see anything after my model is imported:

Scale can vary a lot between different models, and the origin is not always at the center. Try to scale up/down the model in order to make it visible. Note: root object is automatically selected after import, so you just need to use the scale shortcut "s" to scale up or down your model. If it's not enough, select a mesh object in hierarchy and use numpad '.' or Blender menu to focus/align the view on it.

Transparency is looking weird, transparent objects are not visible:

Some models are using refraction, and it's not supported by glTF so it's converted to regular transparency. Refraction is easy to spot on a model, you just need to check the Sketchfab version by clicking "View on Sketchfab"

My model has weird seams/normals:

Tangent space import is not working yet so you might experience rendering issue on some models with normal maps. It's something we will improve in the next versions

My model is black, or has weird colors

It can be caused by several limits in material import.

  • The model has vertex colors: Vertex colors are always exported in glTF files (to allow edition) so they are always loaded in Blender. Sometimes this data is wrong or useless, and the author disables it on Sketchfab. You can easily check if the model has this color data by selecting one of the meshes and looking in mesh properties if it has a Vertex colors layer. Fix: remove vertex colors if they are not valid

  • The model has an outline: a way to have an outline on a Sketchfab model is to duplicate the mesh, flip it's faces and make the material single sided. It is not well imported yet, and it can gives some rendering issues. Example of a model with outline:

    • if base and ouline meshes have faces that are very close, Blender can render them totally transparent, so the model will have holes.
    • If your scene has a light casting shadows, it will make the base mesh look dark because of outline mesh casting shadows on it. There are several solutions to fix this.

  • Backface culling: Some models are set to use single sided materials, which is converted into Blender by using a trick with transparency and backfacing property. Fix: look for a "Geometry" node in the graph, removes the "backfacing" link et set the linked node "Mix Shader" factor to 0.

I have a weird behaviour and no error nor warning message shown:

If an error occurs, you will have an error or a stack trace in Blender's console. You can open the console using "Windows => Toggle system console" but this feature is not always available (for example you don't have it on OSX). The workaround is to start Blender from command line: https://docs.blender.org/manual/en/dev/render/workflows/command_line.html . Outputs will be printed in the shell from which you launched Blender.

jewelcraft.title: JewelCraft v3.0.0
jewelcraft.summary: Compatibility Raise minimum requirements to Blender 4.5 Compatibility with Blender 5.2 💎 Spacing Spacing constraint that tethers neighboring gems and propagates motion within a configurable maximum distance, resulting in a compact layout preserving the…
jewelcraft.html:
Compatibility
  • Raise minimum requirements to Blender 4.5
  • Compatibility with Blender 5.2
💎 Spacing

Spacing constraint that tethers neighboring gems and propagates motion within a configurable maximum distance, resulting in a compact layout preserving the intended gap between gems. Contributed by @Artem-Viveritsa

  • Options for restricting effect, snapping, effect distance, tolerance, and strength.
  • Spacing Overlay: new Lock option to lock marked gems in place for spacing constraint.
    • Locked gems spacing overlay is shown as a dashed line.
💎 Auto Prongs

New tool that places prongs automatically between selected gems. Contributed by @Artem-Viveritsa

  • Prongs are created as separate editable objects.
  • Detect curvature when gems are positioned in a curved line, making prongs smaller on the inside.
Add Cutter/Prongs
  • Absolute sizing.
    • Make cutter Handle Top and Hole Bottom absolute values that are identical between all gem sizes.
    • Make prong diameter absolute value.
    • Separate cutter/prong mesh per gem size.
      • Select Linked by Object Data operator selects only same size cutters/prongs.
  • New Seat Depth property.
💎 Incremental Resize

Quick and easy way of resizing selected objects by specified increments.

  • Implemented as a modal operator, use the mouse wheel for individually resizing selected objects.
  • Resize forces final size to be either whole number or in fractional increments.
    • Scaling with step 0.3 will follow this sequence: 0.3, 0.6, 0.9, 1.0, 1.3, 1.6, 1.9, 2.0
  • Step parameters are separated between gems and other objects.
  • Preference to invert mouse wheel direction.

[!NOTE] Due to implementation Esc key, that is usually cancels modal operator, in this case confirms it. But all edits can easily be reverted with a single undo step.

Gem Map

Performance!

  • Display THOUSANDS of gems without slowdown.
    • Contributed by @Artem-Viveritsa

💎 Color Palette

  • Create your own gem map palette.
  • Palette Generator tool.
    • Hue modes: Full, Limited, Random.
  • When the palette reaches its limit, incrementally desaturate and brighten the color.
    • Yields three loops of modified color before clamping at white.
Design Report
  • JSON: use an object instead of array for entries (simplifies parsing for languages with strict typing).
  • Use webp for preview image.
    • 10x smaller size with similar quality.
  • Make report even if there are only metadata entries.
UI
  • Edit Gem: Simplify settings.
    • Previously, operator settings were hard to understand at first glance, make them granular and in line with other operators.
    • ❌ Previous options:
      • Only ID
      • Force Edit
    • 💎 New options:
      • Affect Gems Only
      • Edit ID/Mesh/Material
  • Weighting: Return click to rename library list functionality.
  • Viewport: auto text color depending on background.
  • Icons: decide dark/light theme on background color, not text color.
Translations
  • Update Chinese (Traditional).
    • Provided by @bisechen
  • Tweak terminology and case for all translations.
Fixed
  • Add-on settings are not initialized after the first registration.
  • Gem Map: color linear/sRGB discrepancy.
  • Add Cutter: girdle offset missing on rectangular cuts.
  • Spacing Override error when no active object.
Project
  • Tools.
    • Build extension zip and generate server index json.
    • Find redundant translation entries.
    • Update po file entries to match reference translation.
  • Include release asset files, including icons, blend files, default settings, etc.
    • Store binary files with LFS.
    • Significantly easier to set up a local dev branch.
  • Tests.
    • Coverage: object tools.

jewelcraft.html:
Automatic Updates

Starting from this release JewelCraft no longer ships with auto updater, Blender 4.2 will handle add-on updates, to make use of that follow these steps:

  1. Uninstall current instance of the add-on.
  2. Enable Preferences → Allow Online Access option.
  3. Install add-on using drag and drop link method.
  4. That will prompt dialog box to add remote repository, after adding it you can install JewelCraft from withing Blender Preferences → Get Extensions tab.

jewelcraft.summary: Compatibility Raise minimum requirement to Blender 3.5 Compatibility with Blender 4.0 Overlay New Gem Map overlay. Can be shown behind objects (default), or in front. By default, shows only for nearby gems, similar to Spacing overlay. Option for opacity…

Compatibility
  • Raise minimum requirement to Blender 3.5
  • Compatibility with Blender 4.0
Overlay
  • New Gem Map overlay.
  • Can be shown behind objects (default), or in front.
  • By default, shows only for nearby gems, similar to Spacing overlay.
  • Option for opacity control.
Gem Map
  • Make use of new overlay to make it work realtime in viewport.
  • Forbid running multiple operator instances and show error message when trying to do so.
Microprong Cutter
  • New Channel cutter: generate simple parametric channel cutter throughout the length of the distribution.
  • Separate Offset transform option for each cutter type.
Geometry Nodes

Migrate some tools to use geometry nodes, makes them more parametric and future proof (Blender eventually will remove face and object instancing functionality).

  • Mirror

    • Copy object instances instead of objects.
    • Mirror instances are inside single object.
    • Old behavior (duplicating objects) is accessible through the option.
    • Mirroring along multiple axes now behaves similar to Mirror modifier.

  • Radial Instance

    • Mirror instances are inside single object.

  • Instance Face

    • Instead of parent to instance face object, use collection to specify objects to be instanced.
    • Scale and rotation no longer cause transform artifacts on instances (finally!)
    • Optionally create pivot point (empty) object if original objects located away from the center of the scene.

  • Microprong (partially)

    • Use GN to generate Channel cutter.
UI
  • Weighting library: get rid of implementation details in operators' description, make it shorter and clearer.
Fixed
  • Spacing Overlay: Fix inverted instances not showing.
  • Microprong Cutter: Fix handling cyclic distribution.
  • Weighting library UI: Fix alignment.
  • Gem Map: table intersects with tool header in viewport.

jewelcraft.title: JewelCraft v2.12.0-blender3.0.0 — Improvements and Blender 3 compatibility
jewelcraft.summary: Localization Refactor Use .po files instead of .json for translations. Cache translation dictionary to .pickle file (speedup startup time). Fix whitespace and dot issues with translations. Gem Map Optimize drawing, 4x speedup with 300 gems in the scene. New…
jewelcraft.html:
Localization Refactor
  • Use .po files instead of .json for translations.
  • Cache translation dictionary to .pickle file (speedup startup time).
  • Fix whitespace and dot issues with translations.
Gem Map
  • Optimize drawing, 4x speedup with 300 gems in the scene.
  • New option to use viewport background.
  • Remove Limit By Selection option.
Design Report/Gem Map
  • Include all visible gems.
  • Remove Possible gem instance face leftovers warning.

Before it tried to filter out instance face original gem objects so users wouldn't need to realize instances in order to get valid report. But it interfered with collection instancing. Now it is user's responsibility to make sure redundant gems do not get into report.

Gem Map/Asset Preview

Force following render defaults:

  • Disable viewport overlays.
  • Disable shading outline.
  • Disable dither.
Microprong Cutter Refactor
  • Create both cutter types at the same time.
  • Use toggles to disable one or another type.

Side Cutter

  • Parent side cutter to a gem. It does not make sense to distribute side cutter on a curve separately from its gem. Instead parent to a gem similar to Add Cutter tool.
  • Add wedge and wedge bevel to side cutter.
  • Allow use with single object, to add side cutter.

Between Cutter

  • Add additional cutters before first and after last gem.
  • With cyclic distribution add only one cutter between first and last gem.
Add Cutter Presets
  • Store shape information with preset. That means tool will force switch to using cutter shape that corresponds with original gem given preset was created with.
Distribute on Curve
  • Reset sizes list.

Distribute always kept sizes list from previous use. Which made it too easy to miss difference in item size when distributing new objects, especially when they differ by only 0.2 mm. Now reset sizes list on every use, Ctrl + tool combination can be used to keep the previous settings, similar to Add Cutter and Prongs tools.

Redistribute
  • Detect cyclic distribution.
  • Fix unnecessary scaling.
Measurement Refactor
  • Weight multiple objects, use collection instead of object as a target.

Better default measurement names:

  • Weight: White Gold 18K.
  • Ring size: Ring Size (Diameter).
  • Dimensions: Dimensions Cube.
Weighting
  • Allow non-mesh objects in volume calculation. Now it is users responsibility to make sure curves and text objects are manifold.
Fixed
  • Fix empty weighting library on File Open/New/Revert.
  • Microprong Cutter: fix error with no active object.

jewelcraft.summary: Assets Add To Library Type property: Selected Objects > Object. This is aimed at Blender asset manager compatibility, as it defines asset as a singular datablock, that means groups of objects cannot be an asset. To make multiple objects into asset use Type…
jewelcraft.html:
Assets
  • Add To Library Type property: Selected Objects > Object.
    • This is aimed at Blender asset manager compatibility, as it defines asset as a singular datablock, that means groups of objects cannot be an asset.
    • To make multiple objects into asset use Type Collection.
Distribute on Curve
  • Redistribute can now change number and size of distributed objects with objects list (similar to Distribute tool).
  • It does so by recreating distribution from scratch, that means if distribution uses different object data (or children), it will be lost in the process.
  • If there is no changes to objects list, then previous behavior is used (deform only).
Interface

jewelcraft.title: JewelCraft v2.9.0-blender2.90.0 — Across-The-Board Improvements
jewelcraft.summary: Gem Map New Use viewport region size for Save to Image. Scale Save to Image result with scene render Resolution Percentage setting. Support Save to Image from camera view, in which case scene render resolution will be used. Gem Map/Design Report apply…
jewelcraft.html:
Gem Map

New

  • Use viewport region size for Save to Image.
  • Scale Save to Image result with scene render Resolution Percentage setting.
  • Support Save to Image from camera view, in which case scene render resolution will be used.
  • Gem Map/Design Report apply preferences on first run only.
  • Use Blender theme options for onscreen text.

Removed

  • Gem Map resolution preference/operator settings.
Design Report Warnings

New

  • Collection visibility warning, warn about gems from hidden collection appearing in report.
  • Option to disable all warnings.

Removed

  • Hidden gems warning.
  • Gem Map operator warning options.
  • Preference warning options, now warnings can be disabled only in operator settings.
Distribute on Curve
  • Add Item behavior changes.
    • Insert new item right after selected item.
    • Inherit size of selected item.
Add Cutter

Complete refactor

  • Streamline, split up, organize and isolate code, now it is readable and easy to build upon.
  • Removed dependence on mesh element index, which makes code more reliable and easier to follow.
  • Significant performance improvement on high detail models.

Interface

  • Round cut: access to Curve Seat.
  • Heart cut: add 3rd factor option for girdle z coordinates.
  • Pear cut: use Culet Position Offset.
  • Heart/Pear cuts: decouple handle/hole shift property.
  • Emerald/Baguette cuts: Cullet Length option.

Fixed

  • Triangle cut inverted normals when using bevel corners and curve profile on low steps setting.

Removed

  • Redundant UI properties, such as toggle for Bevel Corners.
Add Prong

Major refactor

  • Significant performance improvement on high detail models.

Interface

  • Dial down operator properties step values, previous values felt too snappy.
  • Detalization option: lower minimum value from 12 to 3 (not really useful, but there is no point in keeping high minimum too).

Fixed

  • Oval cut preset not activating.
Spacing Overlay
  • Cache control.
    • Before spacing overlay cache size was hardcoded at 128, now make so initial cache size is 64, but it will increase up to 512 if number of gem instances in the scene is greater than current cache size.
    • Disable cache if there are more than 512 gem instances in the scene.
Lazy Load
  • Complete lazy load refactor, now on startup add-on only loads modules required for registration. This results in faster Blender startup times, nothing significant, but it adds up with every enabled add-on.

  • When current scene is not saved, let user choose save location with File Browser.
  • Save to text file is no longer available.
  • Show error message if report is empty.
  • Video demonstration.
Gem Map
  • Gems at the back no longer overlap gems that are in front.
Recover Gem
  • New tool: Recover Gem.
  • Main purpose is to convert imported gems from STL file, by separating loose mesh, centering origin and guessing possible orientation (but can also be used to fix existing gems with busted geometry).
  • Video demonstration.
  • Sponsored (sponsor undisclosed).
Spacing Overlay
  • New find nearest coordinate implementation.
  • Speedup up to 50 times compare to the previous method.
  • Distance overlay no longer constrained to 64 vertices and now smoothly transitions along the radius when moving gems.
Distribute on Curve
  • Support distribution of gems with different sizes.
    • Achieve by proportionally scale original object.
    • Size property is determined by object Y dimension.
  • Video demonstration.
  • Sponsored by Artyom Beskrovniy.
Curve Length
  • Now takes modifiers into account.
    • This also affects: Stretch and Distribute on Curve.
Cutter and Prongs
  • Proportionally scale generated mesh to fit all gems, useful when gems of different sizes are selected.
    • Scaling goes from active object (original size) to selected objects (scaled).
  • New Tool: Microprong Cutter.
    • Create microprong cutter between or on side of selected gems.
    • Cutter between gems does not scale.
    • Works only on distributed gems.
    • Video demonstration.
    • Sponsored by Artyom Beskrovniy.
UI
  • JewelCraft Object menu: available at 3D View > Object > JewelCraft.
    • Now assign whole menu, or certain panels to shortcuts or put in Quick Favorites.
  • Add Size Curve: improve popup UI.
    • Update ring size when modifying Diameter/Circumference property.
    • Show warning if there is no corresponding ring size.
  • Weighting Set.
    • Use marked weighting set as default in dropdown list.
    • Remove [JewelCraft] prefix for default sets.
  • Auto-theme icons.
    • Automatically choose dark or light theme icons based on Blender UI theme.
  • Naming.
    • Product Report > Design Report.
    • Widgets > Spacing Overlay.
    • Curve Scatter > Distribute on Curve.
  • Tweaks to UI layout for Blender 2.90.
Fixed
  • Redistribute ignores Follow Path constraints when using non English locale.
  • Asset library popup translates library names.
  • Gem Map: viewport alpha issues in Blender 2.90.
  • Edit Gem: gem increase in size when changing to certain cuts.
  • Stretch: deformed object does not stretch to the full length of the curve.
  • Add Cutter: error using Curved Seat and Round Corners.
  • Weighting Set: error on new file if marked weighting set no longer exist.
Removed
  • Design Report: save to text file.
  • Add Gem ID operator: deprecated since JewelCraft 2.4.0.
  • Convert Deprecated Gem IDs operator.
  • Design Report: deprecated IDs detection.
  • Preferences: Icons property (use auto-theme instead).

jewelcraft.title: JewelCraft v2.7.0 — Favorites!
jewelcraft.summary: Workflow Favorite your most used assets to quickly access them later from a single favorites collection. Favorites collection is saved to a json file, located in add-on config folder. UI Favorites displayed in alphabetical order, grouped by category and…
jewelcraft.html:
Workflow
  • Favorite your most used assets to quickly access them later from a single favorites collection.
  • Favorites collection is saved to a json file, located in add-on config folder.
UI
  • Favorites displayed in alphabetical order, grouped by category and library.
  • New toggle in sidebar, next to library popover, to quickly switch to favorites and back.
  • New tool: Favorite/Remove From Favorites, located under asset preview, "star" icon.
    • Also displays asset favorite/non-favorite state.
Quality of Life
  • Save asset libraries list into json file, located in add-on config folder.
  • Asset category no longer resets to default value when switching between libraries.
Configuration Folder
  • Relocate config folder on Windows and Linux. Previously system folders for application datafiles were used, now use folders for configurations.
    • Windows
      • Before: ~\AppData\Local\Blender\JewelCraft
      • Now: ~\AppData\Roaming\Blender Foundation\Blender\JewelCraft
    • Linux
      • Before: ~/.local/share/Blender/JewelCraft
      • Now: ~/.config/blender/JewelCraft
  • Support portable config location. Create .config folder inside add-on directory, it will automatically override system config folder. Useful for testing multiple Blender versions with different JewelCraft settings.
    • WARNING: auto update will remove add-on directory along with portable config folder, use it at your own risk!

jewelcraft.title: JewelCraft v2.6.0 — Asset Manager Rework
jewelcraft.summary: Workflow Add multiple asset libraries and switch between them on the fly. There is no longer a default library folder, user has to set it manually. Video demonstration. Interface Asset manager now uses traditional grid layout. Asset preview size can be defined…
jewelcraft.html:
Workflow
  • Add multiple asset libraries and switch between them on the fly.
  • There is no longer a default library folder, user has to set it manually.
  • Video demonstration.
Interface
  • Asset manager now uses traditional grid layout.
  • Asset preview size can be defined in preferences.
  • Switch between asset libraries in Sidebar (popover left to the category dropdown).
  • Filter assets by name.
  • Updated Add Gem preview images to match Blender 2.8x UI style (they are themeable now).
Removed
  • Old asset manager UI.
  • Asset manager Use Custom Library Folder and Library Folder Path preference properties (replaced with Libraries list).
  • Weighting sets Use Custom Library Folder preference property (Library Folder property is now always in use).
Deprecated
  • Default library folders for Asset Manager and Weighting Sets are deprecated (Weighting Sets default library folder moved to add-on configuration directory).
  • Currently add-on checks for deprecated library folders and automatically sets them in preferences, though that is to be removed in future versions.

send2ue.html:
Unreal Engine Assets Exporter - Release Log

Release Logs: https://github.com/xavier150/Blender-For-UnrealEngine-Addons/wiki/Release-Logs

Version 4.4.8
  • New: Skeletal Mesh Socket clipboard is now ordered by socket name. Changed: Better UI for collision and socket in Tools panel.
  • Fixed: Socket UI uses the wrong value and produces script warning in the console. (Case issue: bfu_socket_custom_Name -> bfu_socket_custom_name)
  • Fixed: During export child objects may change their position. (reparenting of duplicated objects may change the object position because of inverse transform.)
  • Fixed: Static Mesh Socket transforms are wrong with gltf exports. (I added fix for FBX export transform but gltf export should not use that fix or it will produce wrong transform.)
  • Fixed: Skeletal Mesh Socket transform is wrong with fbx exports when unit scale is not 0.01. (The Copy Skeletal Mesh socket button doesn't apply spacing rescale)

send2ue.title: Blender for Unreal Engine v4.4.7
send2ue.summary: Unreal Engine Assets Exporter - Release Log Release Logs: https://github.com/xavier150/Blender-For-UnrealEngine-Addons/wiki/Release-Logs Version 4.4.7 New: Support Blender 5.2. New: "Export self only" option for object export type. (This allows to export only…
send2ue.html:
Unreal Engine Assets Exporter - Release Log

Release Logs: https://github.com/xavier150/Blender-For-UnrealEngine-Addons/wiki/Release-Logs

Version 4.4.7
  • New: Support Blender 5.2.
  • New: "Export self only" option for object export type. (This allows to export only the object without its children.)
  • Fixed: The export did not correctly rescale all objects when the hierarchy was non-linear. (Re-parenting was not applied correctly after duplication, so rescaling was not applied to them.)
  • Fixed: Animation export produce script fail in older versions of Blender (4.3 and below). (This was due to the use of a new API in Blender 4.4, which is not available in older versions. "bpy.types.ActionSlot")
  • Fixed: Asset cache don't setup the animation correctly after reinstalling the addon without restarting Blender. (This was due to enum class comparison. Should use "Enum.value == Enum.value" instead of "Enum == Enum" to compare enum values.)
  • Fixed: Addon GitHub link is wrong.
  • Fixed: Open latest release page button in addon preferences does not work. (This was due to the use of deprecated function "os.system". Use "webbrowser.open" instead.)
  • Fixed: Export fail with modular skeletal mesh when a object is not in the scene. (Not what will just send a warning in the console log.)

send2ue.html:
Unreal Engine Assets Exporter - Release Log

Version 4.4.6
  • New: Support Unreal Engine 5.8.
  • New: New preset apply operator to apply a preset to selected objects.
  • Fixed: Import script fail in Unreal Engine 5.0 due to InterchangePipeline typing.
  • Fixed: Import script set but don't apply LOD Group to Static Meshes in older Unreal Engine version. (This is due to a bug on older version that is now fixed.)
  • Fixed: Alembic import produce script fail.
  • Fixed: When Blender enum value matches not enum in a property the export can produce script fail. (Enum will now return a default value instead)
  • Fixed: When the export fails because of the internal exporter, the addon will detect it and indicate it in the console.
  • Fixed: Modular Skeleton Export don't use the sub folder in the export path.

send2ue.title: Blender for Unreal Engine v4.4.5
send2ue.summary: Unreal Engine Assets Exporter - Release Log Release Logs: https://github.com/xavier150/Blender-For-UnrealEngine-Addons/wiki/Release-Logs Version 4.4.5 New: Support for Blender 5.1. New: New automatic fix for "Armature Child with Bone Parent" potential issue.…
send2ue.html:
Unreal Engine Assets Exporter - Release Log

Release Logs: https://github.com/xavier150/Blender-For-UnrealEngine-Addons/wiki/Release-Logs

Version 4.4.5
  • New: Support for Blender 5.1.
  • New: New automatic fix for "Armature Child with Bone Parent" potential issue. When this issue is detected, you can now automatically fix it by converting the bone parent to an armature modifier.
  • New: New automatic fix for "Armature Multiple Root Bones" potential issue. When this issue is detected, you can now automatically fix it by adding a new root bone and reparenting the existing root bones to it.
  • New: New check potential issue for check number of UV maps.
  • New: Native support for Unreal Engine 5.5 camera sensor offset (shift_x and shift_y).
  • Fixed: Light Map UVs operator was not registered properly, causing errors when trying to use it.
  • Fixed: bfu_build_nanite_mode property was using the wrong label. (It was labeled "Light Map" instead of "Build Nanite".)
  • Fixed: Camera export produce script fail in Blender 5.0 due to changes in the Action API.
  • Fixed: Camera delta_scale was not restored after export.
